 150      GainCommand tick(const TunerInput& in) {
 151          // 速度门控（§3.10.6，R1 内收：门控阈值是 Params，判定不再依赖调用方）
 152          enabled_ = (in.speedKn <= p_.highSpeedDeactivateKn);
 153  
 154          // 基线未建立：当前增益跟随调度名义值（P11：否则 ESC 增益每拍被调度表覆盖）
 155          if (!baselineEstablished_) { curKp_ = in.schedKp; curKd_ = in.schedKd; }
 156  
 157          // 周期辨识评估（P6：仅物理合理才配置；P12：漂移超阈值才显式重基线）
 158          if (enabled_ && in.id.excited && in.id.valid) {
 159              applyEstimate_(in.id.K, in.id.T, oscDetector_.amplitude(),
 160                             /*driftGate=*/true, /*forceRebase=*/false);
 161          }
 162  
 163          // P12 振荡检测门控（R1 随迁）：参考稳定满 kOscRefSettleSec 才喂入——
 164          // 参考机动期间误差摆动是指令响应而非闭环振荡
 165          if (in.headingRefDeg != prevRef_) { prevRef_ = in.headingRefDeg; refAgeSec_ = 0.0; }
 166          else                              { refAgeSec_ += in.dt; }
 167          const double e = angleDiffDeg(in.headingRefDeg, in.headingDeg);
 168          accumulate(e, in.rudderDeg, refAgeSec_ >= kOscRefSettleSec);
 169  
 170          // ESC 窗口结算（R1 内收：窗口拍数按 windowSec/dt 换算，计数器自维护）
 171          const uint32_t winBeats = (p_.dt > 0.0)
 172              ? static_cast<uint32_t>(std::max(1.0, p_.windowSec / p_.dt + 0.5))
 173              : 3000u;
 174          if (++winCounter_ >= winBeats) {
 175              winCounter_ = 0;
 176              settleWindow_(in.id);
 177          }
 178  
 179          // ESC 扰动注入（P11：窗口运行期间实际施加到增益的载波；不持久化）
 180          double Kp = curKp_, Kd = curKd_;
 181          if (baselineEstablished_) escDither(Kp, Kd);
 182          return {Kp, Kd};
 183      }

 214      double computeJ() const {
 215          if (windowErr_.empty()) return 0.0;
 216          double J = 0.0;
 217          double t = 0.0;
 218          const size_t n = windowErr_.size();
 219          for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i, t += p_.dt) {
 220              J += (t * windowErr_[i] + p_.wU * windowDelta_[i] + p_.wDu * windowDDelta_[i]) * p_.dt;
 221          }
 222          return J;
 223      }

 228      static bool polePlacement(double K, double T,
 229                                 double zeta, double wn,
 230                                 double& Kp, double& Kd) {
 231          if (!std::isfinite(K) || !std::isfinite(T)) return false;
 232          if (std::abs(K) < 1e-6 || std::abs(T) < 1e-6) return false;
 233          Kp = wn * wn * T / K;
 234          double kdRaw = (2.0 * zeta * wn * T - 1.0) / K;
 235          Kd = kdRaw < 0.0 ? 0.0 : kdRaw;  // 负 Kd 会反向放大振荡，clamp
 236          return true;

 241      bool stabilityCheck(double K, double T,
 242                          double Kp, double Kd,
 243                          double oscAmplitude) const {
 244          if (!std::isfinite(K) || !std::isfinite(T)) return false;
 245          if (std::abs(K) < 1e-6 || std::abs(T) < 1e-6) return false;
 246          if (Kp <= 0.0) return false;
 247          const double wn = std::sqrt(Kp * K / T);
 248          const double zeta = (1.0 + Kd * K) / (2.0 * std::sqrt(T * Kp * K));
 249          if (!std::isfinite(wn) || !std::isfinite(zeta)) return false;
 250          if (zeta < p_.zetaMin) return false;
 251          if (wn > p_.wnMax) return false;
 252          if (oscAmplitude > p_.oscMax) return false;
 253          return true;
 254      }

 265          void update(double e, double /*dt*/) {
 266              const int sign = (e > 0) ? 1 : ((e < 0) ? -1 : 0);
 267              if (sign != 0 && sign != prevSign_ && prevSign_ != 0) {
 268                  // 过零：结算
 269                  if (prevSign_ > 0) {
 270                      // 刚结束正半周期，保存正峰
 271                      lastPosPeak_ = maxPos_;
 272                      maxPos_ = e;  // 重置
 273                  } else {
 274                      // 刚结束负半周期，保存负峰并计算峰-峰
 275                      lastNegPeak_ = minNeg_;
 276                      minNeg_ = e;
 277                      const double pp = lastPosPeak_ - lastNegPeak_;
 278                      if (pp > amp_) amp_ = pp;           // 取较大者（保守）
 279                      else amp_ = 0.9 * amp_ + 0.1 * pp;   // 否则平滑衰减
 280                  }
 281              }
 282              if (sign >= 0 && e > maxPos_) maxPos_ = e;
 283              if (sign <= 0 && e < minNeg_) minNeg_ = e;
 284              if (sign != 0) prevSign_ = sign;
 285          }

 357      void accumulate(double e, double delta, bool oscEligible) {
 358          const double ddelta = delta - prevDelta_;
 359          const double t = windowErr_.size() * p_.dt;  // 本拍在窗口内的时刻（ITAE 时间权重）
 360          windowErr_.push(std::abs(e));
 361          windowDelta_.push(std::abs(delta));
 362          windowDDelta_.push(std::abs(ddelta));
 363          prevDelta_ = delta;
 364          // P4：振荡检测器同步累积原始误差（带符号）
 365          if (oscEligible) oscDetector_.update(e, p_.dt);
 366  
 367          if (!enabled_) return;
 368          // 本拍成本增量（与 computeJ 的被积函数一致）
 369          const double c = (t * std::abs(e) + p_.wU * std::abs(delta)
 370                          + p_.wDu * std::abs(ddelta)) * p_.dt;
 371          // 一阶高通（后向欧拉离散，α 按真实采样周期 dt 计算）去除直流/慢漂
 372          const double alphaH = p_.escHPFtau / (p_.escHPFtau + p_.dt);
 373          hpfY_ = alphaH * (hpfY_ + c - hpfCPrev_);
 374          hpfCPrev_ = c;
 375          // 因果解调：与 escDither() 本拍施加的载波同相相关
 376          demodKpSum_ += hpfY_ * std::sin(escPhase_);
 377          demodKdSum_ += hpfY_ * std::cos(escPhase_);
 378          ++demodCount_;
 379      }

 398      void escStep(double& Kp, double& Kd) {
 399          if (!enabled_) return;
 400  
 401          lastJ_ = computeJ();
 402          // 解调累积量归一化：ĝ = 2·Σ(y·载波)/(a·N) ≈ ∂J/∂(增益相对摄动)
 403          double gKp = 0.0, gKd = 0.0;
 404          if (demodCount_ > 0 && p_.escAmp > 0.0) {
 405              const double norm = 2.0 / (p_.escAmp * static_cast<double>(demodCount_));
 406              gKp = demodKpSum_ * norm;
 407              gKd = demodKdSum_ * norm;
 408          }
 409          // LPF 平滑梯度估计：输入每 windowSec 到达一次，系数按 windowSec 计算
 410          const double alphaL = p_.windowSec / (p_.escLPFtau + p_.windowSec);
 411          gradKp_ = (1.0 - alphaL) * gradKp_ + alphaL * gKp;
 412          gradKd_ = (1.0 - alphaL) * gradKd_ + alphaL * gKd;
 413          // 梯度下降（积分器）+ 更新幅值约束；增益不为负
 414          double newKp = Kp - p_.escStep * gradKp_;
 415          double newKd = Kd - p_.escStep * gradKd_;
 416          newKp = clampUpdate(newKp, Kp);
 417          newKd = clampUpdate(newKd, Kd);
 418          Kp = newKp > 0.0 ? newKp : 0.0;
 419          Kd = newKd > 0.0 ? newKd : 0.0;
 420          // 窗口结算：清空本窗样本与解调累积，下一窗从零开始（非重叠窗）
 421          windowErr_.clear();
 422          windowDelta_.clear();
 423          windowDDelta_.clear();
 424          hpfCPrev_ = 0.0;
 425          hpfY_ = 0.0;
 426          demodKpSum_ = 0.0;
 427          demodKdSum_ = 0.0;
 428          demodCount_ = 0;
 429      }

 455      double clampUpdate(double newVal, double oldVal) const {
 456          // P11 整改：old==0 时比例上限为 0 会永久锁死更新（如极点配置把 Kd 钳到 0），
 457          //           取 max(|old|·frac, absMin)
 458          const double maxDelta = std::max(std::abs(oldVal) * p_.maxUpdateFrac,
 459                                           p_.absMinUpdate);
 460          double d = newVal - oldVal;
 461          if (d >  maxDelta) d =  maxDelta;
 462          if (d < -maxDelta) d = -maxDelta;
 463          return oldVal + d;
 464      }

  82      double step(const SensorInput& s, double dt) {
  83          double rudderCmd = 0.0;
  84  
  85          switch (mode_) {
  86              case Mode::MANUAL:
  87                  rudderCmd = s.rudderDeg;  // 透传
  88                  break;
  89  
  90              case Mode::AUTO_HEADING:
  91                  rudderCmd = headingControlStep(s, dt);
  92                  break;
  93  
  94              case Mode::AUTO_MANEUVER: {
  95                  ManeuverSequencer::Cmd cmd = sequencer_.update(s.headingDeg, s.rateDegS, dt);
  96                  if (sequencer_.done()) {
  97                      // P14：Z 形辨识试验收官——辨识有效则 极点配置+应用，失败保持原增益
  98                      if (identTrial_ == IdentTrialState::RUNNING) finalizeIdentTrial();
  99                      // P11 整改：完成拍不再输出 0（那是绕过舵速限幅的瞬时跳变），
 100                      //           立即转入航向保持并闭环运行本拍
 101                      mode_ = Mode::AUTO_HEADING;
 102                      headingRef_ = s.headingDeg;  // 保持当前航向
 103                      rudderCmd = headingControlStep(s, dt);
 104                      break;
 105                  }
 106                  // P14：辨识试验期间喂辨识器（自降频，任意频率调用均正确；
 107                  //       试验显式发起，不受调参器速度门控影响）
 108                  if (identTrial_ == IdentTrialState::RUNNING) {
 109                      identifier_.update(s.rudderDeg, s.rateDegS, dt);
 110                  }
 111                  if (cmd.isHeading) {
 112                      headingRef_ = cmd.heading;
 113                      // P13 整改：机动 HEADING 段补齐增益调度查询（否则全程停留默认增益，
 114                      //           慢船直航段目标航向丢失）；辨识/ESC 在机动中仍保持挂起。
 115                      double Kp, Kd;
 116                      schedule_.query(s.speedKn, s.seaState, Kp, Kd);
 117                      pd_.setGains(Kp, Kd);
 118                      // P1 整改：用 setDt 替代 setParams，避免切段 reset 清状态
 119                      pd_.setDt(dt);
 120                      rudderCmd = pd_.update(headingRef_, s.headingDeg);
 121                  } else {
 122                      // P7 整改：RUDDER 段经 PD 的 saturate() 施加幅值/舵速限幅
 123                      pd_.setDt(dt);
 124                      rudderCmd = pd_.saturate(cmd.rudder);
 125                  }
 126                  break;
 127              }
 128  
 129              case Mode::HOLD:
 130                  // P9 整改：HOLD 保持上一拍舵角指令（冻结），而非输出 0
 131                  rudderCmd = holdRudder_;
 132                  break;
 133          }
 134          lastRudderCmd_ = rudderCmd;  // P9: 记录用于 HOLD 冻结
 135          return rudderCmd;
 136      }

 151      double headingControlStep(const SensorInput& s, double dt) {
 152          // P11 整改：切入 AUTO_HEADING 的首拍以实际舵角作为舵速限幅基准
 153          if (pendingBaseline_) {
 154              pendingBaseline_ = false;
 155              pd_.initBaseline(s.rudderDeg);
 156          }
 157  
 158          // §3.6 增益调度
 159          double Kp, Kd;
 160          schedule_.query(s.speedKn, s.seaState, Kp, Kd);
 161  
 162          // 辨识器自降频（R1）：任意频率喂，内部满 1 s 才做 RLS 拍
 163          identifier_.update(s.rudderDeg, s.rateDegS, dt);
 164  
 165          // §3.10 自动优化（R1：速度门控/辨识评估/ESC/稳定门/回退/扰动全部内收）
 166          const GainCommand g = tuner_.tick({headingRef_, s.headingDeg, s.rudderDeg,
 167                                            s.speedKn, dt, Kp, Kd, idSnapshot()});
 168  
 169          // P1 整改：用 setGains/setDt 替代 setParams，避免每周期 reset 清空状态
 170          pd_.setDt(dt);
 171          pd_.setGains(g.Kp, g.Kd);
 172          return pd_.update(headingRef_, s.headingDeg);
 173      }

  44          seaState = std::max(0, std::min(3, seaState));
  45  
  46          const GainPoint* prev = nullptr;
  47          double prevMid = 0.0;
  48          for (const auto& pt : table_) {
  49              if (pt.seaState != seaState) continue;
  50              const double mid = 0.5 * (pt.speedMin + pt.speedMax);
  51  
  52              // 低于最低段中点 → 取首段名义值
  53              if (prev == nullptr) {
  54                  if (speedKn <= mid) { Kp = pt.Kp; Kd = pt.Kd; return; }
  55                  prev = &pt;
  56                  prevMid = mid;
  57                  continue;
  58              }
  59  
  60              // 在相邻中点间插值；单次遍历避免控制周期内额外分配内存。
  61              if (speedKn <= mid) {
  62                  const double span = mid - prevMid;
  63                  const double f = (span > 1e-9) ? (speedKn - prevMid) / span : 0.0;
  64                  Kp = prev->Kp + f * (pt.Kp - prev->Kp);
  65                  Kd = prev->Kd + f * (pt.Kd - prev->Kd);
  66                  return;
  67              }
  68              prev = &pt;
  69              prevMid = mid;
  70          }
  71  
  72          if (prev == nullptr) { Kp = 1.0; Kd = 0.5; return; }
  73          // 高于最高段中点（NaN 也落入兜底）→ 取末段名义值
  74          Kp = prev->Kp; Kd = prev->Kd;
  75      }

  46      Cmd update(double headingAct, double rateAct, double dt) {
  47          if (done_ || idx_ < 0 || idx_ >= (int)legs_.size()) {
  48              return {false, 0.0, 0.0};
  49          }
  50  
  51          if (first_) { lastHeading_ = headingAct; first_ = false; }
  52  
  53          // 累计航向变化（带符号最小差）
  54          const double dh = angleDiffDeg(headingAct, lastHeading_);
  55          cumHeading_ += dh;
  56          lastHeading_ = headingAct;
  57          legElapsed_ += dt;
  58  
  59          const Leg& cur = legs_[idx_];
  60          bool advance = false;
  61          switch (cur.trigger) {
  62              case Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED:
  63                  // P12 整改：触发方向敏感——cumHeading 必须沿 threshold 的符号方向
  64                  // 达到其幅值才切段（cum·thr ≥ thr²）。旧逻辑 |cum|≥|thr| 无方向：
  65                  // 反舵后船舶因惯性仍沿旧转向顺漂，cum 继续按旧方向增长，
  66                  // 会在真正转向新方向之前把航段"预触发"。
  67                  if (cumHeading_ * cur.threshold >= cur.threshold * cur.threshold) advance = true;
  68                  break;
  69              case Leg::Trigger::TIME:
  70                  if (legElapsed_ >= cur.threshold) advance = true;
  71                  break;
  72              case Leg::Trigger::RATE:
  73                  if (std::abs(rateAct) <= cur.threshold) advance = true;
  74                  break;
  75              case Leg::Trigger::NONE:
  76                  break;
  77          }
  78  
  79          Cmd cmd;
  80          if (cur.mode == Leg::Mode::HEADING) {
  81              cmd.isHeading = true;
  82              cmd.heading = cur.target;
  83              cmd.rudder = 0.0;
  84          } else {
  85              cmd.isHeading = false;
  86              cmd.heading = 0.0;
  87              cmd.rudder = cur.target;
  88          }
  89  
  90          if (advance) {
  91              // 切段时清零累计量
  92              legElapsed_ = 0.0;
  93              cumHeading_ = 0.0;
  94              idx_ = cur.next;
  95              if (idx_ < 0 || idx_ >= (int)legs_.size()) done_ = true;
  96          }
  97          return cmd;
  98      }

 125      static std::vector<Leg> zigzag(double psi0, double dz = 10.0, double phiz = 10.0,
 126                                      int N = 5, bool returnToStart = false) {
 127          std::vector<Leg> legs;
 128          bool positive = true;
 129          const int totalLegs = 2 * N + (returnToStart ? 1 : 0);
 130          for (int i = 0; i < 2 * N; ++i) {
 131              Leg l;
 132              l.mode = Leg::Mode::RUDDER;
 133              l.target = positive ? +dz : -dz;
 134              l.trigger = Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED;
 135              l.threshold = positive ? +phiz : -phiz;
 136              l.next = (i + 1 < totalLegs) ? (i + 1) : -1;
 137              legs.push_back(l);
 138              positive = !positive;
 139          }
 140          if (returnToStart) {
 141              Leg hold;
 142              hold.mode = Leg::Mode::HEADING;
 143              hold.target = psi0;  // P12 整改：保持目标 = 起始航向 psi0
 144              hold.trigger = Leg::Trigger::NONE;
 145              hold.threshold = 0.0;
 146              hold.next = -1;
 147              legs.push_back(hold);
 148          }
 149          return legs;
 150      }

 167      static std::vector<Leg> cloverleaf(double psi0, double tLeg = 30.0, double dMax = 20.0) {
 168          const double dir = (dMax >= 0.0) ? 1.0 : -1.0;  // 转向方向由 dMax 符号决定
 169          std::vector<Leg> legs;
 170          for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
 171              // 转向段：恒舵角，累计航向变化达 270° 切下一段（四段同向）
 172              // P12 整改：阈值带符号 dir·270°，与舵向一致（左转四叶为 -270°）
 173              Leg turn;
 174              turn.mode = Leg::Mode::RUDDER;
 175              turn.target = dMax;
 176              turn.trigger = Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED;
 177              turn.threshold = dir * 270.0;
 178              turn.next = 2 * i + 1;
 179              legs.push_back(turn);
 180  
 181              // 直航段：保持出转航向 t_leg 秒（= ψ0 + dir·270°·(i+1)）
 182              Leg straight;
 183              straight.mode = Leg::Mode::HEADING;
 184              straight.target = normalizeAngleDeg(psi0 + dir * 270.0 * (i + 1));
 185              straight.trigger = Leg::Trigger::TIME;
 186              straight.threshold = tLeg;
 187              straight.next = (i < 3) ? (2 * i + 2) : -1;
 188              legs.push_back(straight);
 189          }
 190          return legs;
 191      }

 195      static std::vector<Leg> search(double psi0, double t0 = 30.0, double dt = 10.0,
 196                                      int cycles = 6, double dMax = 20.0) {
 197          std::vector<Leg> legs;
 198          double hdg = psi0;
 199          int idx = 0;
 200          for (int c = 0; c < cycles; ++c) {
 201              const double t = t0 + c * dt;
 202              // 直航
 203              Leg straight;
 204              straight.mode = Leg::Mode::HEADING;
 205              straight.target = hdg;
 206              straight.trigger = Leg::Trigger::TIME;
 207              straight.threshold = t;
 208              straight.next = idx + 1;
 209              legs.push_back(straight); ++idx;
 210              // 右转 90°：恒右舵（P12 整改：阈值符号随 dMax 舵向）
 211              hdg = normalizeAngleDeg(hdg + 90.0);
 212              Leg turn;
 213              turn.mode = Leg::Mode::RUDDER;
 214              turn.target = +dMax;
 215              turn.trigger = Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED;
 216              turn.threshold = (dMax >= 0.0) ? 90.0 : -90.0;
 217              turn.next = (c < cycles - 1) ? (idx + 1) : -1;
 218              legs.push_back(turn); ++idx;
 219          }
 220          return legs;
 221      }

  49      bool update(double delta, double r, double dtNow) {
  50          // P6 整改：入口范围校验，超限丢弃该拍（不污染 θ）
  51          // P11 整改：被拒绝的拍不再写入 prevR_——否则 NaN/毛刺会成为下一拍差分锚点，
  52          //           dr=(r-prevR_)/Δt 被污染后经激励门控进入 φ，永久毒化 θ/P
  53          if (!std::isfinite(delta) || !std::isfinite(r)) return false;
  54          if (std::abs(delta) > 35.0 || std::abs(r) > 30.0) return false;
  55          if (!(dtNow > 0.0)) return false;  // 非法采样周期丢弃（防除零/时间倒流）
  56  
  57          // 自降频：未满一个 RLS 拍间隔只累计时间，不做递推
  58          elapsed_ += dtNow;
  59          if (elapsed_ < p_.beatSec) return false;
  60          const double beatDt = elapsed_;  // 自测拍长（≈beatSec，消除调用频率假设）
  61          elapsed_ = 0.0;
  62  
  63          // §3.10.3 激励条件：舵角足够大，且转向率或转向加速度足够大
  64          // （保留 r 过零附近的高 dr 瞬态，否则 T 欠定）
  65          double dr = 0.0;
  66          if (first_) { first_ = false; }
  67          else        { dr = (r - prevR_) / beatDt; }
  68          excited_ = (std::abs(delta) > p_.deltaMin &&
  69                      (std::abs(r) > p_.rMin || std::abs(dr) > p_.drMin));
  70          if (!excited_) {
  71              prevR_ = r;
  72              return false;
  73          }
  74  
  75          // φ = [δ/dScale, -dr/drScale]（归一化，消除量级差导致的病态）
  76          const double phi[2] = { delta / p_.dScale, -dr / p_.drScale };
  77  
  78          // 增益 K_k = P·φ / (λ + φᵀPφ)
  79          double Pphi[2] = {
  80              P_[0][0]*phi[0] + P_[0][1]*phi[1],
  81              P_[1][0]*phi[0] + P_[1][1]*phi[1]
  82          };
  83          const double denom = p_.lambda + phi[0]*Pphi[0] + phi[1]*Pphi[1];
  84          if (std::abs(denom) < 1e-12) { prevR_ = r; return false; }
  85          const double gainK[2] = { Pphi[0]/denom, Pphi[1]/denom };
  86  
  87          // 残差 e = y - φᵀθ
  88          const double y = r;
  89          const double yhat = phi[0]*theta_[0] + phi[1]*theta_[1];
  90          const double err = y - yhat;
  91  
  92          // θ ← θ + K·e
  93          theta_[0] += gainK[0] * err;
  94          theta_[1] += gainK[1] * err;
  95  
  96          // P ← (1/λ)(P - K·φᵀ·P)，加 P-floor 防止协方差塌陷（保持长期自适应）
  97          const double invL = 1.0 / p_.lambda;
  98          const double pFloor = 1e-3;  // 协方差下界
  99          for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
 100              for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
 101                  P_[i][j] = invL * (P_[i][j] - gainK[i]*Pphi[j]);
 102              }
 103          }
 104          // 对角元保底
 105          if (P_[0][0] < pFloor) P_[0][0] = pFloor;
 106          if (P_[1][1] < pFloor) P_[1][1] = pFloor;
 107  
 108          prevR_ = r;
 109          return true;
 110      }

  20  inline uint32_t crc32(const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
  21      uint32_t crc = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
  22      for (size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
  23          crc ^= data[i];
  24          for (int j = 0; j < 8; ++j) {
  25              const uint32_t mask = -(crc & 1u);
  26              crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & mask);
  27          }
  28      }
  29      return ~crc;
  30  }

 186      bool load(ControlParams& p) {
 187          // 先读一个足够大的缓冲（最大支持 4096 字节）
 188          std::vector<uint8_t> full(4096, 0);
 189          if (!read_(full.data(), full.size())) return false;
 190          // 反序列化 payload（不含末尾 4 字节 crc），off 输出消耗字节数
 191          size_t off = 0;
 192          if (!p.deserializeFrom(full.data(), full.size(), off)) return false;
 193          // 末尾 4 字节为 crc
 194          if (off + 4 > full.size()) return false;
 195          uint32_t storedCrc = 0;
 196          for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) storedCrc |= static_cast<uint32_t>(full[off+i]) << (8*i);
 197          p.crc = storedCrc;
 198          return p.verifyCrc();
 199      }

  66      double update(double headingRef, double headingAct) {
  67          // §3.2 角度归一化的航向误差
  68          const double e = angleDiffDeg(headingRef, headingAct);
  69  
  70          // §3.7 误差死区
  71          if (std::abs(e) < p_.deadzone) {
  72              // 死区内目标 0，但仍经 saturate() 舵速限幅回中——
  73              // P11 整改：直接跳 0 会绕过 ddMax（如 35°→0° 瞬时跳变）
  74              prevErr_ = e;
  75              return saturate(0.0);
  76          }
  77  
  78          // §3.7 带滤波的微分（一阶低通）
  79          double derivRaw;
  80          if (first_) {
  81              derivRaw = 0.0;
  82              first_ = false;
  83          } else {
  84              derivRaw = (e - prevErr_) / p_.dt;
  85          }
  86          const double alpha = 1.0 / (1.0 + p_.tau / p_.dt);
  87          const double deriv = alpha * derivRaw + (1.0 - alpha) * prevDeriv_;
  88  
  89          // §3.2 PD 控制律
  90          double out = p_.Kp * e + p_.Kd * deriv;
  91  
  92          // §3.3 舵角限幅
  93          if (out >  p_.dMax) out =  p_.dMax;
  94          if (out < -p_.dMax) out = -p_.dMax;
  95  
  96          // §3.3 舵速限幅
  97          const double maxDelta = p_.ddMax * p_.dt;
  98          const double delta = out - prevOut_;
  99          if (delta >  maxDelta) out = prevOut_ + maxDelta;
 100          if (delta < -maxDelta) out = prevOut_ - maxDelta;
 101  
 102          // §3.7 输出量化
 103          out = quantize(out);
 104  
 105          prevErr_ = e;
 106          prevDeriv_ = deriv;
 107          prevOut_ = out;
 108          return out;
 109      }

  96          else if (a == "--tune") runTuneMode = true;

 109              double d = 0.0;

 112                  return 1;

 129              outPath = v;

 134              printHelp();
 135              return 1;

 139      auto matrix = defaultMatrix();

 141      if (listOnly) {

 146      if (runIdent) {
 147          // RLS 闭环辨识场景
 148          Simulator sim;
 149          sim.dt = 0.02;
 150          double K = (Koverride > 0) ? Koverride : 0.2;
 151          double T = (Toverride > 0) ? Toverride : 8.0;
 152          double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : 120.0;
 153          auto r = sim.runIdent(K, T, 10.0, sec);
 154          std::printf("RLS 辨识结果: K=%.4f (真值 %.2f), T=%.4f (真值 %.2f), valid=%d excited=%d\n",
 155                      r.Khat, K, r.That, T, r.valid, r.excited);
 156          bool ok = r.valid && std::abs(r.Khat - K) < 0.05 && std::abs(r.That - T) < 2.0;
 157          std::printf("%s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
 158          if (!outPath.empty()) { sim.exportLastCsv(outPath); std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", outPath.c_str()); }
 159          return ok ? 0 : 1;
 160      }
 161  
 162      // --trial 跑自动 Z 形辨识试验（P14）
 163      if (runTrial) {
 164          Simulator sim;
 165          sim.dt = 0.02;
 166          const double K = (Koverride > 0) ? Koverride : 0.2;
 167          const double T = (Toverride > 0) ? Toverride : 8.0;
 168          const double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : 300.0;
 169          const double speedKn = (speedOverride > 0) ? speedOverride : 10.0;
 170          auto r = sim.runIdentTrial(K, T, speedKn, sec);
 171          const double errK = (r.Khat - K) / K * 100.0;
 172          const double errT = (r.That - T) / T * 100.0;
 173          std::printf("Z形辨识试验: K=%.3f→K̂=%.4f (%+.1f%%)  T=%.1f→T̂=%.2f (%+.1f%%)  valid=%d  用时 %.0fs\n",
 174                      K, r.Khat, errK, T, r.That, errT, (int)r.identValid, r.trialSec);
 175          std::printf("增益: 试验前 Kp=%.2f Kd=%.2f → 试验后 Kp=%.4f Kd=%.4f  applied=%d\n",
 176                      r.KpOld, r.KdOld, r.KpNew, r.KdNew, (int)r.applied);
 177          if (!outPath.empty()) { sim.exportLastCsv(outPath); std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", outPath.c_str()); }
 178          // PASS：收官应用成功 + 辨识误差 ≤25%（与 --ident 容差一致）
 179          const bool ok = r.applied && std::abs(errK) <= 25.0 && std::abs(errT) <= 25.0;
 180          std::printf("%s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
 181          return ok ? 0 : 1;
 182      }

 184      // --tune 跑自动调参收敛试验（R1 全链路：RLS 辨识 → 极点配置基线 → ESC 窗口寻优）
 185      if (runTuneMode) {
 186          Simulator sim;
 187          sim.dt = 0.02;
 188          const double K = (Koverride > 0) ? Koverride : 0.2;
 189          const double T = (Toverride > 0) ? Toverride : 8.0;
 190          const double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : 1200.0;
 191          const double speedKn = (speedOverride > 0) ? speedOverride : 10.0;
 192          // --leg 覆盖，缺省按 4T 与 4/(ζωn) 自适应（让每段航向基本到达参考值）
 193          const double leg = (legOverride > 0) ? legOverride : sim.autoLegSec(T);
 194          auto r = sim.runTuneConvergence(K, T, speedKn, sec, leg);
 195          std::printf("调参收敛: K=%.2f/T=%.1f v=%.1fkn %ds leg=%.0fs\n", K, T, speedKn, (int)sec, leg);
 196          std::printf("  辨识: K̂=%.4f (%.1f%%), T̂=%.4f (%.1f%%), valid=%d\n",
 197                      r.Khat, (r.Khat - K) / K * 100.0, r.That, (r.That - T) / T * 100.0,
 198                      (int)r.identValid);
 199          std::printf("  基线: %s (t=%.0fs)  增益 Kp %.4f→%.4f  Kd %.4f→%.4f\n",
 200                      r.baselineEstablished ? "建立" : "未建立", r.baselineSec,
 201                      r.Kp0, r.KpFinal, r.Kd0, r.KdFinal);
 202          std::printf("  ESC: 窗口数=%d  J %.1f→%.1f  末3窗散布≤10%%=%d  stable=%d  converged=%d\n",
 203                      r.winCount, r.Jfirst, r.Jlast,
 204                      (r.winCount >= 4 && [&]{
 205                          const auto& sv = r.settles;
 206                          const double jMin = std::min(std::min(sv[sv.size()-3].Jwindow,
 207                                                                sv[sv.size()-2].Jwindow),
 208                                                       sv[sv.size()-1].Jwindow);
 209                          const double jMax = std::max(std::max(sv[sv.size()-3].Jwindow,
 210                                                                sv[sv.size()-2].Jwindow),
 211                                                       sv[sv.size()-1].Jwindow);
 212                          return jMin > 0.0 && (jMax - jMin) / jMin <= 0.10;
 213                      }()) ? 1 : 0,
 214                      (int)r.stable, (int)r.converged);
 215          if (!outPath.empty()) {
 216              sim.exportTuneCsv(r, outPath);
 217              std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", outPath.c_str());
 218          }
 219          return r.converged ? 0 : 1;
 220      }
 221  
 222      // --esc 跑 ESC 长期场景
 223      if (runEscMode) {
 224          Simulator sim;
 225          sim.dt = 0.02;
 226          double K = (Koverride > 0) ? Koverride : 0.2;
 227          double T = (Toverride > 0) ? Toverride : 8.0;
 228          // 默认 480 s：辨识收敛（约 1~2 min）+ 基线建立后再留数个 60 s ESC 评估窗口
 229          double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : 480.0;
 230          // Z 形参考翻转周期（每段参考航向维持时间）：--leg 覆盖，缺省按 4T 与 4/(ζωn) 自适应
 231          double leg = (legOverride > 0) ? legOverride : sim.autoLegSec(T);
 232          auto r = sim.runEsc(K, T, 10.0, sec, leg);
 233          std::printf("ESC 长期: Kp %.4f→%.4f Kd %.4f→%.4f | 辨识 K=%.4f (真值 %.2f) T=%.4f (真值 %.2f) valid=%d | baseline=%d(t=%.0fs) moved=%d stable=%d | leg=%.0fs\n",
 234                      r.Kp0, r.KpFinal, r.Kd0, r.KdFinal,
 235                      r.Khat, K, r.That, T, r.identValid ? 1 : 0,
 236                      r.baselineEstablished ? 1 : 0, r.baselineSec,
 237                      r.gainsMoved ? 1 : 0, r.stable ? 1 : 0, leg);
 238          // PASS：辨识收敛且物理合理 + 基线建立（ESC 真正启动过）+ 增益确实移动 + 数值稳定有界
 239          // 任一不满足即 FAIL——ESC 从未启动时增益与初值逐位相同，moved=0，必然 FAIL
 240          bool ok = r.identValid && r.baselineEstablished && r.gainsMoved && r.stable;
 241          std::printf("%s\n", ok ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
 242          if (!outPath.empty()) { sim.exportLastCsv(outPath); std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", outPath.c_str()); }
 243          return ok ? 0 : 1;
 244      }
 245  
 246      // --validate 跑全验证矩阵 + 实时性测量
 247      if (runValidateMode) {
 248          double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : 120.0;
 249          std::printf("%-22s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %10s %s\n",
 250                      "case","overshoot","settle","ess1σ","bias","freq","maxStepμs","PASS");
 251          bool allPass = true;
 252          // 典型 + 边界船参，无干扰/有干扰（带干扰工况用海况 1 基准扰动幅值）
 253          struct V { const char* name; double K, T; bool dist; };
 254          std::vector<V> vs = {
 255              {"typical_nodist", 0.2, 8.0, false},
 256              {"typical_dist",   0.2, 8.0, true},
 257              {"fast_nodist",    0.5, 3.0, false},
 258              {"slow_nodist",    0.1, 20.0, false},
 259          };
 260          for (auto& v : vs) {
 261              // 每次新建仿真器以隔离状态
 262              Simulator s; s.dt = 0.02;
 263              auto r = s.runValidation(v.K, v.T, 10.0, v.dist ? 1 : 0, 30.0, v.dist, sec);
 264              std::printf("%-22s %7.2f%% %7.2fs %7.3f %7.3f %7.2f %9.1f %s\n",
 265                          v.name, r.overshootPct, r.settlingTime, r.ess1Sigma, r.essBias,
 266                          r.rudderFreq, r.maxStepMicros, r.pass?"PASS":"FAIL");
 267              if (!outPath.empty()) {
 268                  std::string p = outPath;
 269                  auto dot = p.find_last_of('.');
 270                  if (dot != std::string::npos)
 271                      p = p.substr(0, dot) + "_" + v.name + p.substr(dot);
 272                  else
 273                      p = p + "_" + v.name;
 274                  s.exportLastCsv(p);
 275                  std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", p.c_str());
 276              }
 277              if (!r.pass) allPass = false;
 278          }
 279          std::printf("%s\n", allPass ? "ALL PASS" : "SOME FAIL");
 280          return allPass ? 0 : 1;
 281      }
 282  
 283      // --maneuver <name> 跑六机动形态场景
 284      if (runManeuverMode) {
 285          Simulator sim; sim.dt = 0.02;
 286          double K = (Koverride > 0) ? Koverride : 0.2;
 287          double T = (Toverride > 0) ? Toverride : 8.0;
 288          double sec = (secOverride > 0) ? secOverride : defaultManeuverSec(maneuverName);
 289          double speedKn = (speedOverride > 0) ? speedOverride : 10.0;
 290          bool   dist = hasDistOverride ? distOverride : false;
 291          // 未显式指定海况时：带干扰默认海况 1（基准扰动幅值），无干扰为 0
 292          int    seaState = (seaOverride >= 0) ? seaOverride : (dist ? 1 : 0);
 293          sim.enableDisturbance = dist;
 294          std::vector<ar::Leg> legs;
 295          if (maneuverName == "williamson") legs = ManeuverSequencer::williamson(0.0);
 296          else if (maneuverName == "uturn")  legs = ManeuverSequencer::uTurn(0.0, true);
 297          else if (maneuverName == "zigzag") legs = ManeuverSequencer::zigzag(0.0, 10.0, 15.0, 3);
 298          else if (maneuverName == "circles") legs = ManeuverSequencer::circles(15.0, 360.0);
 299          // 直航段时长随 T 缩放：慢船出转超调大，20 s 直航拉不回目标航向（四叶畸变），tLeg≈2.5T 才够消超调
 300          // 注意签名为 cloverleaf(psi0, tLeg, dMax)
 301          else if (maneuverName == "cloverleaf") legs = ManeuverSequencer::cloverleaf(0.0, std::max(20.0, 2.5 * T), 20.0);
 302          else if (maneuverName == "search")   legs = ManeuverSequencer::search(0.0, 20.0, 10.0, 4);
 303          else { std::fprintf(stderr, "未知机动: %s\n", maneuverName.c_str()); return 1; }
 304          auto r = sim.runManeuver(legs, K, T, speedKn, seaState, sec);
 305          bool ok = r.completed && r.maxRudder <= 36.0;  // 序列真实执行完毕 + 限幅生效（含余量）
 306          std::printf("机动 %-12s K=%.2f T=%.2f v=%.1fkn sea=%d dist=%d: completed=%d seqDone=%d maxH=%.1f° maxR=%.1f° %s\n",
 307                      maneuverName.c_str(), K, T, speedKn, seaState, (int)dist,
 308                      r.completed, r.seqDone, r.maxHeading, r.maxRudder, ok?"PASS":"FAIL");
 309          if (!outPath.empty()) { sim.exportLastCsv(outPath); std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", outPath.c_str()); }
 310          return ok ? 0 : 1;
 311      }
 312  
 313      std::vector<Scenario> targets;
 314      if (runAll) targets = matrix;
 315      else {
 316          bool found = false;
 317          for (const auto& s : matrix) if (s.name == scenarioName) { targets.push_back(s); found = true; break; }
 318          if (!found) { std::printf("场景未找到: %s\n", scenarioName.c_str()); return 1; }
 319      }
 320  
 321      std::printf("%-16s %6s %6s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %s\n",
 322                  "scenario", "K", "T", "overshoot", "settle", "ess1σ", "bias", "freq", "PASS");
 323      bool allPass = true;
 324      for (auto sc : targets) {
 325          if (Koverride > 0) sc.K = Koverride;
 326          if (Toverride > 0) sc.T = Toverride;
 327          if (speedOverride > 0) sc.speedKn = speedOverride;   // 进入增益调度查询
 328          if (seaOverride >= 0) sc.seaState = seaOverride;     // 进入增益调度查询 + 扰动强度
 329          if (secOverride > 0) sc.totalSec = secOverride;
 330  
 331          Simulator sim;
 332          sim.plant.K = sc.K;
 333          sim.plant.T = sc.T;
 334          sim.dt = 0.02;
 335          if (hasDistOverride) sim.enableDisturbance = distOverride;
 336          SimResult r = sim.runStep(sc.speedKn, sc.seaState, sc.stepDeg, sc.holdSec, sc.totalSec);
 337  
 338          std::printf("%-16s %6.2f %6.2f %7.2f%% %7.2fs %7.3f %7.3f %7.2f %s\n",
 339                      sc.name.c_str(), sc.K, sc.T,
 340                      r.overshootPct, r.settlingTime, r.ess1Sigma, r.essBias, r.rudderFreq,
 341                      r.pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL");
 342          if (!r.pass) allPass = false;
 343  
 344          if (!outPath.empty()) {
 345              std::string p = outPath;
 346              if (targets.size() > 1) {
 347                  auto dot = p.find_last_of('.');
 348                  if (dot != std::string::npos)
 349                      p = p.substr(0, dot) + "_" + sc.name + p.substr(dot);
 350                  else
 351                      p = p + "_" + sc.name;
 352              }
 353              sim.exportCsv(r, p);
 354              std::printf("CSV 导出: %s\n", p.c_str());
 355          }
 356      }
 357      std::printf("%s\n", allPass ? "ALL PASS" : "SOME FAIL");
 358      return allPass ? 0 : 1;
 359  }

  26      void step(double deltaCmd, double dt, double disturb = 0.0) {
  27          // 舵机一阶惯性 + 限幅
  28          double ddot = (deltaCmd - deltaAct) / tauS;
  29          if (ddot >  ddotMax) ddot =  ddotMax;
  30          if (ddot < -ddotMax) ddot = -ddotMax;
  31          deltaAct += ddot * dt;
  32          if (deltaAct >  dMax) deltaAct =  dMax;
  33          if (deltaAct < -dMax) deltaAct = -dMax;
  34  
  35          // Nomoto: T·dr + r = K·(deltaAct + disturb)
  36          const double deltaEff = deltaAct + disturb;
  37          const double dr = (K * deltaEff - r) / T;
  38          r += dr * dt;
  39          psi += r * dt;
  40          // 航向归一化到 (-180, 180]
  41          while (psi >  180.0) psi -= 360.0;
  42          while (psi <= -180.0) psi += 360.0;
  43      }

  70                                         {0.0, 100.0, 1, Kp, Kd},
  71                                         {0.0, 100.0, 2, Kp, Kd},
  72                                         {0.0, 100.0, 3, Kp, Kd}});
  73          }

  84          const int holdSteps  = static_cast<int>(holdSec / dt);
  85          const int stepStep   = holdSteps;  // 阶跃施加时刻

  88          int dirChanges = 0;
  89          std::vector<double> errSteady;
  90  
  91          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
  92              double t = k * dt;
  93              if (k == stepStep) ap.setHeadingRef(stepDeg);
  94

 111                  sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;

 113                  sm.err = sm.psiRef - sm.psi;

 125                      if ((prevRudderCmd > 0 && cmd < 0) || (prevRudderCmd < 0 && cmd > 0))
 126                          ++dirChanges;
 127                  }
 128              }

 168      IdentResult runIdent(double K, double T, double speedKn, double totalSec) {
 169          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 170          lastSamples.clear();
 171          ap.setMode(Mode::MANUAL);  // 手动注入舵角激励
 172          // 用极点配置增益保持闭环稳定的同时叠加 Z 形
 173          const double Kp = wnTarget * wnTarget * T / K;
 174          const double Kd = (2.0 * zetaTarget * wnTarget * T - 1.0) / K;
 175          ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, Kp, Kd}});
 176          // 启用自动优化路径让辨识器运行
 177          auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 178          tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = 100.0;  // 始终启用
 179          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 180  
 181          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(totalSec / dt);
 182          // Z 形激励：每 10 s 翻转一次 ±20°
 183          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 184              double t = k * dt;
 185              double zDelta = (static_cast<int>(t / 10.0) % 2 == 0) ? 20.0 : -20.0;
 186              SensorInput s;
 187              s.headingDeg = plant.psi;
 188              s.rateDegS   = plant.r;
 189              s.rudderDeg  = plant.deltaAct;
 190              s.speedKn    = speedKn;
 191              s.seaState  = 0;
 192              // 手动模式：直接把 zDelta 作为舵指令注入（绕过 PD）
 193              // 但 autopilot MANUAL 返回 0，所以用 AUTO_HEADING + 大幅航向阶跃等效激励
 194              ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 195              ap.setHeadingRef(zDelta * 5);  // 大幅航向目标产生大舵角
 196              double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 197              plant.step(cmd, dt, 0.0);
 198              if (k % recordEvery == 0) {
 199                  Sample sm; sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi;
 200                  sm.psiRef = zDelta * 5; sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;
 201                  sm.rate = plant.r; sm.err = sm.psiRef - plant.psi;
 202                  sm.Kp = ap.pd().params().Kp; sm.Kd = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 203                  sm.mode = static_cast<int>(ap.mode());
 204                  lastSamples.push_back(sm);
 205              }
 206          }
 207          IdentResult r;
 208          r.Khat = ap.identifier().K();
 209          r.That = ap.identifier().T();
 210          r.valid = ap.identifier().valid();
 211          r.excited = ap.identifier().excited();
 212          return r;
 213      }

 232      EscResult runEsc(double K, double T, double speedKn, double totalSec,
 233                       double legSec = 0.0) {
 234          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 235          lastSamples.clear();
 236          ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 237          // 用极点配置增益作调度表基线
 238          const double Kp0 = wnTarget * wnTarget * T / K;
 239          const double Kd0 = (2.0 * zetaTarget * wnTarget * T - 1.0) / K;
 240          ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, Kp0, Kd0}});
 241          // Z 形（zigzag）航向参考：每 legSec 在 ±refAmp 间翻转，全程确定性激励
 242          // legSec ≤ 0 时按 autoLegSec(T) 自适应，保证每段维持时间足够航向到达参考值
 243          const double refAmp = 40.0;  // deg
 244          if (legSec <= 0.0) legSec = autoLegSec(T);
 245  
 246          // 启用自动优化
 247          auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 248          tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = 100.0;
 249          // ESC 实验优化（仅本试验参数，不改算法缺省）：
 250          //  1) 评估窗口取 2 个完整 zigzag 周期（=4 段）：每窗激励组成一致，
 251          //     消除 J 拍频；zigzag 基频落在 2 周/窗（方波谐波在 6、10… 周/窗），
 252          //     与 1 周/窗的载波正交——窗口若取 1 个 zigzag 周期，激励基频与
 253          //     载波同频，解调梯度被激励污染（实测方向错误、沿梯度上坡）。
 254          //  2) 载波每窗恰好一个整周期（ω=2π/windowSec），解调无频谱泄漏；
 255          //     HPF 转角取载波频率的 1/3 以下（tau=0.5·windowSec），否则衰减
 256          //     并旋转载波分量（缺省 tau=5s 对 0.049 rad/s 载波衰减 ~4 倍）；
 257          //     LPF 取半窗长做梯度平滑。
 258          //  3) 结构化激励下指令响应的误差摆动会被振荡检测器当作闭环振荡
 259          //     （实测峰-峰 7~11° > 缺省 oscMax=5°），导致稳定门每窗回退、
 260          //     增益冻结；无扰动仿真放宽 oscMax，由 ζ/ωn 代数条件把关。
 261          //  4) 两阶段激励：基线建立前 ±refAmp 充分激励辨识；建基线后降为
 262          //     ±refAmpCalm——大幅值 Z 形让舵饱和，ITAE 只奖励"更快"，ESC 会
 263          //     把增益推到 ζ 安全边界并反复回退锯齿；小摆幅下代价对超调/振荡
 264          //     敏感，才存在内部最优点。
 265          tp.windowSec = 4.0 * legSec;
 266          tp.escFreq   = 2.0 * 3.14159265358979323846 / tp.windowSec;
 267          tp.escHPFtau = 0.5 * tp.windowSec;
 268          tp.escLPFtau = 0.5 * tp.windowSec;
 269          tp.oscMax    = 20.0;
 270          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 271          const int legSteps  = static_cast<int>(legSec / dt);
 272          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(totalSec / dt);
 273          const double refAmpCalm = 15.0;  // deg，阶段 2（ESC 寻优）摆幅，见上注 4)
 274          double curRef = refAmp;
 275          ap.setHeadingRef(curRef);
 276  
 277          double KpFinal = Kp0, KdFinal = Kd0;
 278          bool   baselineSeen = false;
 279          double baselineSec  = -1.0;
 280          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 281              double t = k * dt;
 282              if (k > 0 && k % legSteps == 0) {
 283                  curRef = (curRef > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0) * (baselineSeen ? refAmpCalm : refAmp);
 284                  ap.setHeadingRef(curRef);
 285              }
 286              SensorInput s;
 287              s.headingDeg = plant.psi;
 288              s.rateDegS   = plant.r;
 289              s.rudderDeg  = plant.deltaAct;
 290              s.speedKn    = speedKn;
 291              s.seaState  = 0;
 292              double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 293              plant.step(cmd, dt, 0.0);
 294              KpFinal = ap.pd().params().Kp;
 295              KdFinal = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 296              // 基线建立观测（R1：AutoTuner 提供 baselineEstablished() 只读 getter，
 297              // 替代旧版"增益偏离调度表值 1e-9 反推内部状态"的迂回断言）
 298              if (!baselineSeen && ap.tuner().baselineEstablished()) {
 299                  baselineSeen = true;
 300                  baselineSec  = t;
 301              }
 302              if (k % recordEvery == 0) {
 303                  Sample sm; sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi;
 304                  sm.psiRef = curRef; sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;
 305                  sm.rate = plant.r; sm.err = curRef - plant.psi;
 306                  sm.Kp = KpFinal; sm.Kd = KdFinal;
 307                  sm.mode = static_cast<int>(ap.mode());
 308                  lastSamples.push_back(sm);
 309              }
 310          }
 311          EscResult r;
 312          r.Kp0 = Kp0; r.Kd0 = Kd0;
 313          r.KpFinal = KpFinal; r.KdFinal = KdFinal;
 314          r.Khat = ap.identifier().K();
 315          r.That = ap.identifier().T();
 316          r.identValid = ap.identifier().valid();
 317          r.baselineEstablished = baselineSeen;
 318          r.baselineSec = baselineSec;
 319          // 增益移动判据：Kp 或 Kd 相对起点偏移 > 1%（基线接管+ESC 调参的共同效果）
 320          r.gainsMoved = (std::abs(KpFinal - Kp0) > 0.01 * Kp0)
 321                      || (std::abs(KdFinal - Kd0) > 0.01 * Kd0);
 322          // 稳定性：增益与船态有限、Kp 不发散（沿用原有界判据精神，Kd 同法）
 323          r.stable = std::isfinite(KpFinal) && std::isfinite(KdFinal)
 324                  && std::isfinite(plant.psi) && std::isfinite(plant.r)
 325                  && KpFinal > 0.0 && KpFinal < Kp0 * 5.0
 326                  && KdFinal >= 0.0 && KdFinal < Kd0 * 5.0;
 327          return r;
 328      }

 366      TuneResult runTuneConvergence(double K, double T, double speedKn, double totalSec,
 367                                    double legSec = 0.0) {
 368          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 369          lastSamples.clear();
 370          ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 371          const double Kp0 = wnTarget * wnTarget * T / K;
 372          const double Kd0 = (2.0 * zetaTarget * wnTarget * T - 1.0) / K;
 373          ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, Kp0, Kd0}});
 374          const double refAmp = 40.0;
 375          const double refAmpCalm = 15.0;  // deg，基线建立后的 ESC 寻优摆幅（runEsc 注 4）
 376          if (legSec <= 0.0) legSec = autoLegSec(T);
 377          // ESC 实验优化（仅本试验参数，不改算法缺省）：窗口对齐 zigzag 周期、
 378          // 载波每窗一个整周期、结构化激励下放宽 oscMax 由 ζ/ωn 代数条件把关
 379          // （依据见 runEsc 同名牌注）
 380          auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 381          tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = 100.0;   // 始终启用（速度门控不在本试验考察范围）
 382          tp.windowSec = 4.0 * legSec;
 383          tp.escFreq   = 2.0 * 3.14159265358979323846 / tp.windowSec;
 384          tp.escHPFtau = 0.5 * tp.windowSec;
 385          tp.escLPFtau = 0.5 * tp.windowSec;
 386          tp.oscMax    = 20.0;
 387          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 388  
 389          const int legSteps  = static_cast<int>(legSec / dt);
 390          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(totalSec / dt);
 391          const int recEvery  = static_cast<int>(1.0 / dt);  // 每 1 s 记录一行
 392          double curRef = refAmp;
 393          ap.setHeadingRef(curRef);
 394  
 395          TuneResult r;
 396          r.Kp0 = Kp0; r.Kd0 = Kd0;
 397          bool baselineSeen = false;
 398          int  winIndex = 0;
 399          double Jpre = 0.0;
 400          double KpPre = Kp0, KdPre = Kd0;
 401          bool finite = true;
 402  
 403          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 404              const double t = k * dt;
 405              if (k > 0 && k % legSteps == 0) {
 406                  curRef = (curRef > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0) * (baselineSeen ? refAmpCalm : refAmp);
 407                  ap.setHeadingRef(curRef);
 408              }
 409              SensorInput s;
 410              s.headingDeg = plant.psi;
 411              s.rateDegS   = plant.r;
 412              s.rudderDeg  = plant.deltaAct;
 413              s.speedKn    = speedKn;
 414              s.seaState   = 0;
 415  
 416              // 结算前读窗口 J（当前窗满 2999/3000 拍；结算在 tick 内清除）
 417              Jpre = ap.tuner().computeJ();
 418              ap.tuner().currentGains(KpPre, KdPre);
 419              const double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 420              plant.step(cmd, dt, 0.0);
 421  
 422              // 基线建立事件
 423              if (!baselineSeen && ap.tuner().baselineEstablished()) {
 424                  baselineSeen = true;
 425                  r.baselineSec = t;
 426              }
 427              // 窗口结算事件：tick 结算后窗口被清空（J 从 >0 掉到 0）
 428              const double Jpost = ap.tuner().computeJ();
 429              double KpPost = KpPre, KdPost = KdPre;
 430              ap.tuner().currentGains(KpPost, KdPost);
 431              if (baselineSeen && Jpre > 0.0 && Jpost == 0.0) {
 432                  TuneSample se;
 433                  se.t = t;
 434                  se.KpCenter = KpPre; se.KdCenter = KdPre;
 435                  se.Jwindow  = Jpre;
 436                  se.winIndex = ++winIndex;
 437                  se.Kp = KpPost; se.Kd = KdPost;   // 结算后持久增益
 438                  se.Khat = ap.identifier().K();
 439                  se.That = ap.identifier().T();
 440                  se.identValid = ap.identifier().valid();
 441                  se.baseline = true;
 442                  r.settles.push_back(se);
 443                  if (winIndex == 1) { r.Jfirst = Jpre; }
 444                  r.Jlast = Jpre;
 445              }
 446  
 447              // 每 1 s 采样行
 448              if (k % recEvery == 0) {
 449                  TuneSample sm;
 450                  sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi; sm.psiRef = curRef;
 451                  sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;
 452                  sm.rate = plant.r; sm.err = curRef - plant.psi;
 453                  sm.Kp = ap.pd().params().Kp; sm.Kd = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 454                  ap.tuner().currentGains(sm.KpCenter, sm.KdCenter);
 455                  sm.Khat = ap.identifier().K(); sm.That = ap.identifier().T();
 456                  sm.identValid = ap.identifier().valid();
 457                  sm.baseline = ap.tuner().baselineEstablished();
 458                  if (Jpost == 0.0 && Jpre > 0.0) {  // 结算拍：行内携带窗口 J
 459                      sm.Jwindow = Jpre;
 460                      sm.winIndex = winIndex;
 461                  }
 462                  r.samples.push_back(sm);
 463                  lastSamples.push_back({sm.t, sm.psi, sm.psiRef, sm.rudderCmd,
 464                                         sm.rudderAct, sm.rate, sm.err,
 465                                         sm.Kp, sm.Kd, static_cast<int>(ap.mode())});
 466              }
 467              finite = finite && std::isfinite(plant.psi) && std::isfinite(plant.r)
 468                            && std::isfinite(cmd) && std::isfinite(KpPost) && std::isfinite(KdPost);
 469          }
 470  
 471          r.KpFinal = ap.pd().params().Kp;  // 含载波；中心值取最后一次采样
 472          r.KdFinal = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 473          r.Khat = ap.identifier().K();
 474          r.That = ap.identifier().T();
 475          r.identValid = ap.identifier().valid();
 476          r.baselineEstablished = baselineSeen;
 477          r.winCount = winIndex;
 478          r.stable = finite && r.KpFinal > 0.0 && r.KpFinal < Kp0 * 5.0
 479                           && r.KdFinal >= 0.0 && r.KdFinal < Kd0 * 5.0;
 480          // 收敛判据：
 481          //   (a) 基线建立且辨识物理合理；
 482          //   (b) 基线后至少结算 4 个窗口，末 3 窗 J 相对散布 ≤ 10%（平台）；
 483          //   (c) 末窗 J 不劣于首窗（≤ +2%），且 K̂/T̂ 相对真值偏差 ≤ 25%；
 484          //   (d) 全程数值有界。
 485          if (baselineSeen && r.identValid && winIndex >= 4 && r.stable) {
 486              const auto& sv = r.settles;
 487              const double Jlast3[3] = {
 488                  sv[sv.size()-3].Jwindow, sv[sv.size()-2].Jwindow, sv[sv.size()-1].Jwindow
 489              };
 490              const double jMin = std::min(Jlast3[0], std::min(Jlast3[1], Jlast3[2]));
 491              const double jMax = std::max(Jlast3[0], std::max(Jlast3[1], Jlast3[2]));
 492              const bool jPlateau = jMin > 0.0 && (jMax - jMin) / jMin <= 0.10;
 493              const bool jNotWorse = r.Jlast <= r.Jfirst * 1.02;
 494              const bool identClose = std::abs(r.Khat - K) / K <= 0.25
 495                                   && std::abs(r.That - T) / T <= 0.25;
 496              r.converged = jPlateau && jNotWorse && identClose;
 497          }
 498          return r;
 499      }

 537      ManeuverResult runManeuver(const std::vector<Leg>& legs, double K, double T,
 538                                  double speedKn, int seaState, double totalSec) {
 539          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 540          lastSamples.clear();
 541          ap.setMode(Mode::MANUAL);
 542          ap.startManeuver(legs);
 543          dist.setSeaState(seaState);
 544          // 用极点配置增益（覆盖全部海况行，避免查询回退默认增益）
 545          const double Kp = wnTarget * wnTarget * T / K;
 546          const double Kd = (2.0 * zetaTarget * wnTarget * T - 1.0) / K;
 547          ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, Kp, Kd},
 548                                     {0.0, 100.0, 1, Kp, Kd},
 549                                     {0.0, 100.0, 2, Kp, Kd},
 550                                     {0.0, 100.0, 3, Kp, Kd}});
 551          auto tp = ap.tuner().params(); tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = -1.0;
 552          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 553  
 554          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(totalSec / dt);
 555          double maxH = 0.0, maxR = 0.0;
 556          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 557              double t = k * dt;
 558              SensorInput s;
 559              s.headingDeg = enableDisturbance ? dist.noisyHeading(plant.psi) : plant.psi;
 560              s.rateDegS   = enableDisturbance ? dist.noisyRate(plant.r) : plant.r;
 561              s.rudderDeg = plant.deltaAct; s.speedKn = speedKn; s.seaState = seaState;
 562              double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 563              plant.step(cmd, dt, enableDisturbance ? dist.disturbAngle(t) : 0.0);
 564              maxH = std::max(maxH, std::abs(plant.psi));
 565              maxR = std::max(maxR, std::abs(cmd));
 566              if (k % recordEvery == 0) {
 567                  Sample sm; sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi;
 568                  sm.psiRef = 0.0; sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;
 569                  sm.rate = plant.r; sm.err = 0.0;
 570                  sm.Kp = ap.pd().params().Kp; sm.Kd = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 571                  sm.mode = static_cast<int>(ap.mode());
 572                  lastSamples.push_back(sm);
 573              }
 574          }
 575          ManeuverResult r;
 576          r.maxHeading = maxH;
 577          r.maxRudder = maxR;
 578          // 完成判据：机动序列在仿真时长内真实执行完毕——
 579          //   (a) 序列器 done()：末段触发条件已满足（zigzag/circles/cloverleaf/search 等）；
 580          //   (b) 或已进入末段且末段为 trigger=NONE 的保持段（williamson/uTurn 的
 581          //       末段 HEADING 保持永不推进，到达该段即视为完成）。
 582          // 若自动驾驶仪无输出，航向不变，HEADING_REACHED 触发永不满足，序列停在
 583          // 首段，completed=false。另要求全程数值有限（发散/NaN 判 FAIL）。
 584          const int lastIdx = static_cast<int>(legs.size()) - 1;
 585          const bool reachedFinalHold = lastIdx >= 0
 586              && ap.sequencer().currentIndex() == lastIdx
 587              && legs.back().trigger == Leg::Trigger::NONE;
 588          r.seqDone = ap.sequencer().done() || reachedFinalHold;
 589          r.completed = r.seqDone && std::isfinite(maxH) && std::isfinite(maxR);
 590          return r;
 591      }

 605                                double dz = 20.0, double phiz = 20.0, int cycles = 4) {
 606          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 607          lastSamples.clear();

 610                                     {0.0, 100.0, 1, 1.0, 0.5},
 611                                     {0.0, 100.0, 2, 1.0, 0.5},
 612                                     {0.0, 100.0, 3, 1.0, 0.5}});
 613          auto tp = ap.tuner().params(); tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = -1.0;
 614          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 615          dist.setSeaState(0);
 616          ap.startIdentifyTrial(dz, phiz, cycles);
 617  
 618          TrialResult r;
 619          r.KpOld = 1.0; r.KdOld = 0.5;
 620          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(maxSec / dt);
 621          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 622              const double t = k * dt;
 623              SensorInput s;
 624              s.headingDeg = plant.psi; s.rateDegS = plant.r;
 625              s.rudderDeg = plant.deltaAct; s.speedKn = speedKn; s.seaState = 0;
 626              const double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 627              plant.step(cmd, dt);
 628              r.trialSec = t;
 629              if (k % recordEvery == 0) {
 630                  Sample sm; sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi;
 631                  sm.psiRef = 0.0; sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct;
 632                  sm.rate = plant.r; sm.err = 0.0;
 633                  sm.Kp = ap.pd().params().Kp; sm.Kd = ap.pd().params().Kd;
 634                  sm.mode = static_cast<int>(ap.mode());
 635                  lastSamples.push_back(sm);
 636              }
 637              if (ap.identTrialState() != IdentTrialState::RUNNING) break;  // 收官即停
 638          }
 639          r.Khat = ap.identifier().K(); r.That = ap.identifier().T();
 640          r.identValid = ap.identifier().valid();
 641          r.applied = (ap.identTrialState() == IdentTrialState::OK);
 642          r.KpNew = ap.pd().params().Kp; r.KdNew = ap.pd().params().Kd;

 652      ValidationResult runValidation(double K, double T, double speedKn, int seaState,
 653                                      double stepDeg, bool withDisturbance, double totalSec) {
 654          plant.K = K; plant.T = T; plant.reset(0.0);
 655          ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 656          ap.setHeadingRef(0.0);
 657          const double Kp = wnTarget * wnTarget * T / K;
 658          const double Kd = (2.0 * zetaTarget * wnTarget * T - 1.0) / K;
 659          ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, Kp, Kd},
 660                                     {0.0, 100.0, 1, Kp, Kd},
 661                                     {0.0, 100.0, 2, Kp, Kd},
 662                                     {0.0, 100.0, 3, Kp, Kd}});
 663          auto tp = ap.tuner().params(); tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = -1.0;
 664          ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 665          dist.setSeaState(seaState);
 666          // 注意：不写成员 enableDisturbance——本函数全程使用局部 withDisturbance，
 667          // 避免跨调用残留状态
 668  
 669          SimResult sr;
 670          sr.samples.clear();
 671          lastSamples.clear();
 672          const int totalSteps = static_cast<int>(totalSec / dt);
 673          const int holdSteps = static_cast<int>(10.0 / dt);
 674          double prevRudderCmd = 0.0;
 675          int dirChanges = 0;
 676          std::vector<double> errSteady;
 677          double maxStepMicros = 0.0;
 678  
 679          for (int k = 0; k < totalSteps; ++k) {
 680              double t = k * dt;
 681              if (k == holdSteps) ap.setHeadingRef(stepDeg);
 682  
 683              SensorInput s;
 684              s.headingDeg = withDisturbance ? dist.noisyHeading(plant.psi) : plant.psi;
 685              s.rateDegS   = withDisturbance ? dist.noisyRate(plant.r) : plant.r;
 686              s.rudderDeg  = plant.deltaAct;
 687              s.speedKn    = speedKn;
 688              s.seaState  = seaState;
 689  
 690              // 实时性测量
 691              auto t0 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
 692              double cmd = ap.step(s, dt);
 693              auto t1 = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
 694              double us = std::chrono::duration<double, std::micro>(t1 - t0).count();
 695              if (us > maxStepMicros) maxStepMicros = us;
 696  
 697              plant.step(cmd, dt, withDisturbance ? dist.disturbAngle(t) : 0.0);
 698  
 699              if (k % recordEvery == 0) {
 700                  Sample sm; sm.t = t; sm.psi = plant.psi;
 701                  sm.psiRef = (k >= holdSteps) ? stepDeg : 0.0;
 702                  sm.rudderCmd = cmd; sm.rudderAct = plant.deltaAct; sm.rate = plant.r;
 703                  sm.err = sm.psiRef - plant.psi; sm.Kp = ap.pd().params().Kp;
 704                  sm.Kd = ap.pd().params().Kd; sm.mode = static_cast<int>(ap.mode());
 705                  sr.samples.push_back(sm);
 706                  lastSamples.push_back(sm);
 707              }
 708              if (k > 0) {
 709                  double d = cmd - prevRudderCmd;
 710                  if (std::abs(d) > 0.1 && ((prevRudderCmd > 0 && cmd < 0) || (prevRudderCmd < 0 && cmd > 0)))
 711                      ++dirChanges;
 712              }
 713              prevRudderCmd = cmd;
 714              if (k > totalSteps - static_cast<int>(20.0 / dt) && k >= holdSteps)
 715                  errSteady.push_back((k >= holdSteps ? stepDeg : 0.0) - plant.psi);
 716          }
 717          // 复用 computeMetrics 逻辑
 718          computeMetrics(sr, stepDeg, 10.0, totalSec, dirChanges, errSteady);
 719          ValidationResult vr;
 720          vr.overshootPct = sr.overshootPct;
 721          vr.settlingTime = sr.settlingTime;
 722          vr.ess1Sigma = sr.ess1Sigma;
 723          vr.essBias = sr.essBias;
 724          vr.rudderFreq = sr.rudderFreq;
 725          vr.maxStepMicros = maxStepMicros;
 726          // PASS：指标达标 + 单拍耗时 < 5 ms（50 Hz 周期 20 ms，留 4 倍余量）
 727          vr.pass = sr.pass && maxStepMicros < 5000.0;
 728          return vr;
 729      }

 733      void computeMetrics(SimResult& res, double stepDeg, double tStepSec, double totalSec,
 734                          int dirChanges, const std::vector<double>& errSteady) {
 735          if (res.samples.empty()) return;
 736          // 超调：符号感知，且忽略阶跃前保持段。
 737          //   正阶跃取 max(ψ)-stepDeg；负阶跃取 stepDeg-min(ψ)
 738          double overshoot = 0.0;
 739          {
 740              bool any = false;
 741              double extremum = 0.0;
 742              for (const auto& s : res.samples) {
 743                  if (s.t < tStepSec) continue;
 744                  if (!any) { extremum = s.psi; any = true; }
 745                  else if (stepDeg >= 0.0) extremum = std::max(extremum, s.psi);
 746                  else                     extremum = std::min(extremum, s.psi);
 747              }
 748              if (any) overshoot = (stepDeg >= 0.0) ? (extremum - stepDeg)
 749                                                    : (stepDeg - extremum);
 750          }
 751          res.overshootPct = (std::abs(stepDeg) > 1e-9) ? (overshoot / std::abs(stepDeg)) * 100.0 : 0.0;
 752  
 753          // 5% 调节时间：从阶跃施加时刻起算，误差进入 ±5%·|stepDeg| 带后不再离开
 754          // 所需的时间（= 阶跃后最后一次越带时刻 - tStepSec；全程不越带为 0；
 755          // 迟迟不进带则接近总时长，自然判 FAIL）
 756          const double band = 0.05 * std::abs(stepDeg);
 757          double lastExit = tStepSec;
 758          for (const auto& s : res.samples) {
 759              if (s.t < tStepSec) continue;
 760              if (std::abs(s.err) > band) lastExit = s.t;
 761          }
 762          res.settlingTime = (lastExit > tStepSec) ? (lastExit - tStepSec) : 0.0;
 763  
 764          // 稳态 1σ 与偏置 |mean|（偏置暴露 PD 无积分在恒风下的系统性误差）
 765          if (!errSteady.empty()) {
 766              double mean = 0.0;
 767              for (double e : errSteady) mean += e;
 768              mean /= errSteady.size();
 769              double var = 0.0;
 770              for (double e : errSteady) var += (e - mean) * (e - mean);
 771              var /= errSteady.size();
 772              res.ess1Sigma = std::sqrt(var);
 773              res.essBias = std::abs(mean);
 774          }
 775  
 776          // 操舵频次
 777          res.rudderFreq = dirChanges * 60.0 / totalSec;
 778  
 779          // 判 PASS/FAIL（§1.5，原阈值不变；新增稳态偏置判据 |mean| ≤ 1°）
 780          res.pass = (res.overshootPct <= 10.0)
 781                  && (res.settlingTime <= 30.0)
 782                  && (res.ess1Sigma <= 1.0)
 783                  && (res.essBias <= 1.0)
 784                  && (res.rudderFreq <= 6.0);
 785      }

 100  TEST(AutoTuner, OscillationDetectorResetClearsPeaks) {

 112      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(det.amplitude(), 1.0);
 113  }

 141  TEST(AutoTuner, WindowSettleUpdateIsClamped) {
 142      AutoTuner::Params p;
 143      p.windowSec = 10.0;              // 500 拍窗口
 144      p.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI / 5.0;    // 载波 5 s 周期，每窗 2 个整周期
 145      AutoTuner t(p);
 146      const IdSnapshot snap = makeSnap(0.2, 8.0);
 147      ASSERT_TRUE(t.establishBaseline(snap));  // 基线 (1.6, 8.6)
 148      double KpB, KdB;  // 与 establishBaseline 内部同一计算，取精确值供回退断言
 149      ASSERT_TRUE(AutoTuner::polePlacement(0.2, 8.0, p.zeta, p.wn, KpB, KdB));
 150      double Kp = KpB, Kd = KdB;
 151      // 累积 10 个窗口的样本（误差渐增）；逐窗校验：
 152      //   ESC 更新受 clampUpdate 约束（≤ max(|old|·frac, absMin)），
 153      //   或被稳定门拒绝时 revert 跳回基线（安全机制，幅值不受梯度钳制）
 154      for (int w = 0; w < 10; ++w) {
 155          for (int k = 0; k < 500; ++k) {
 156              const double e = 1.0 + 0.1 * k;
 157              t.tick(mkInput(0.0, -e, 5.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, snap));  // e = angleDiffDeg(0, -e)
 158          }
 159          double KpNow, KdNow;
 160          t.currentGains(KpNow, KdNow);
 161          EXPECT_TRUE(std::isfinite(KpNow));
 162          EXPECT_TRUE(std::isfinite(KdNow));
 163          const bool clamped =
 164              std::abs(KpNow - Kp) <= std::max(std::abs(Kp) * p.maxUpdateFrac, p.absMinUpdate) + 1e-12 &&
 165              std::abs(KdNow - Kd) <= std::max(std::abs(Kd) * p.maxUpdateFrac, p.absMinUpdate) + 1e-12;
 166          const bool reverted =
 167              std::abs(KpNow - KpB) <= 1e-9 && std::abs(KdNow - KdB) <= 1e-9;
 168          EXPECT_TRUE(clamped || reverted)
 169              << "Kp " << Kp << "→" << KpNow << ", Kd " << Kd << "→" << KdNow;
 170          Kp = KpNow; Kd = KdNow;
 171      }
 172  }

 177  TEST(AutoTuner, EscTunesKpTowardOptimum) {
 178      AutoTuner::Params p;
 179      p.windowSec = 60.0;
 180      p.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI / 60.0;  // 每窗 1 个载波周期（慢于闭环响应，拟稳态成立）
 181      p.escAmp = 0.10; p.escHPFtau = 30.0; p.escLPFtau = 10.0; p.escStep = 0.02;
 182      AutoTuner t(p);
 183      // 故意偏低的起点基线 (0.15, 0.5)：快照取 K=40/31, T=150/31 使极点配置恰好产出之
 184      const IdSnapshot snap = makeSnap(40.0 / 31.0, 150.0 / 31.0);
 185      ASSERT_TRUE(t.establishBaseline(snap));
 186      PdController::Params pp;
 187      pp.Kp = 0.15; pp.Kd = 0.5; pp.dt = 0.02; pp.deadzone = 0.0;
 188      pp.ddMax = 100.0; pp.quant = 0.01;
 189      PdController pd(pp);
 190      const double K = 0.5, T = 2.0, dt = 0.02;
 191      double heading = 0.0, rate = 0.0, deltaPrev = 0.0;
 192      double Jfirst = 0.0, Jlast = 0.0;
 193      const int winBeats = static_cast<int>(p.windowSec / dt);
 194      for (int w = 0; w < 8; ++w) {
 195          for (int k = 0; k < winBeats; ++k) {
 196              const double tt = k * dt;
 197              const double ref = 20.0 * std::sin(2.0 * M_PI * tt / 30.0);  // 窗口整数倍周期
 198              // 生产拍序：tick（用上拍舵角反馈）→ 应用增益 → PD → 对象
 199              GainCommand g = t.tick(mkInput(ref, heading, deltaPrev, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, snap));
 200              pd.setGains(g.Kp, g.Kd);
 201              const double delta = pd.update(ref, heading);
 202              rate = (K * delta * dt + T * rate) / (T + dt);  // Nomoto 一阶：T·ṙ+r=K·δ
 203              heading += rate * dt;
 204              deltaPrev = delta;
 205              if (k == winBeats - 2) {  // 窗末结算前一拍读 J（结算后窗口清零）
 206                  const double J = t.computeJ();
 207                  if (w == 0) Jfirst = J;
 208                  Jlast = J;
 209              }
 210          }
 211      }
 212      double KpEnd, KdEnd;
 213      t.currentGains(KpEnd, KdEnd);
 214      EXPECT_GT(KpEnd, 0.15 + 0.03);  // 向改善方向（增大）移动
 215      EXPECT_LT(Jlast, Jfirst);       // 窗口成本下降
 216  }

 219  TEST(AutoTuner, EscUpdateUnsticksFromZeroKd) {
 220      AutoTuner::Params p;
 221      p.windowSec = 10.0;
 222      p.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI / 2.5;  // 2.5 s 载波周期，每窗 4 个整周期
 223      AutoTuner t(p);
 224      // 基线 (1.0, 0.0)：快照 K=2/17, T=50/17 使极点配置恰好产出
 225      const IdSnapshot snap = makeSnap(2.0 / 17.0, 50.0 / 17.0);
 226      ASSERT_TRUE(t.establishBaseline(snap));
 227      // 注入与 Kd 载波（cos）负相关的成本序列 → 梯度指向增大 Kd
 228      // （phase 与内部载波同步：基线建立后每拍推进 escFreq·dt）
 229      long beat = 0;
 230      for (int w = 0; w < 3; ++w) {
 231          for (int k = 0; k < 500; ++k, ++beat) {
 232              const double phase = std::fmod(beat * p.escFreq * p.dt, 2.0 * M_PI);
 233              const double e = 5.0 - 3.0 * std::cos(phase);
 234              t.tick(mkInput(0.0, -e, 0.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, snap));
 235          }
 236          double KpNow, KdNow;
 237          t.currentGains(KpNow, KdNow);
 238          EXPECT_TRUE(std::isfinite(KdNow));
 239      }
 240      double KpEnd, KdEnd;
 241      t.currentGains(KpEnd, KdEnd);
 242      EXPECT_GT(KdEnd, 0.0);  // 从 0 解锁
 243      // 且每窗移动不超过绝对下限（梯度大时钳到 absMinUpdate）
 244      EXPECT_LE(KdEnd, 3.0 * p.absMinUpdate + 1e-12);
 245  }

 289  TEST(AutoTuner, RebaselineClearsIntegratorState) {
 290      AutoTuner::Params p;
 291      p.windowSec = 10.0;
 292      p.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI / 2.5;  // 2.5 s 载波，每窗 4 个整周期
 293      AutoTuner t(p);
 294      ASSERT_TRUE(t.establishBaseline(makeSnap(0.2, 8.0)));   // 基线 A (1.6, 8.6)
 295      // 半个窗口的 cos 负相关成本 → 解调累积非零（未结算）
 296      for (int k = 0; k < 250; ++k) {
 297          const double phase = std::fmod(k * p.escFreq * p.dt, 2.0 * M_PI);
 298          t.tick(mkInput(0.0, -(5.0 - 3.0 * std::cos(phase)), 0.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, IdSnapshot{}));
 299      }
 300      // 显式重基线 B：窗口样本与解调累积必须作废
 301      ASSERT_TRUE(t.establishBaseline(makeSnap(0.5, 3.0)));
 302      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(t.computeJ(), 0.0);  // 旧窗口成本围绕旧增益测得，不得保留
 303      double KpB, KdB;  // 与 establishBaseline 内部同一计算，取精确值（避免字面量 ULP 差）
 304      ASSERT_TRUE(AutoTuner::polePlacement(0.5, 3.0, p.zeta, p.wn, KpB, KdB));
 305      // 重锚后跑满一个零成本窗口并结算：若旧解调累积残留，结算会再次施加它
 306      for (int k = 0; k < 500; ++k) {
 307          t.tick(mkInput(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 0.0, 0.0, IdSnapshot{}));
 308      }
 309      double KpNow, KdNow;
 310      t.currentGains(KpNow, KdNow);
 311      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(KpNow, KpB);
 312      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(KdNow, KdB);
 313  }

  89  TEST(AutopilotCore, ManeuverCompletesToAutoHeading) {
  90      AutopilotCore ap;
  91      auto legs = ManeuverSequencer::circles(15.0, 90.0);
  92      ap.startManeuver(legs);
  93      EXPECT_EQ(ap.mode(), Mode::AUTO_MANEUVER);

  96      double prevCmd = 0.0, completionCmd = 0.0;

  99          s.headingDeg = hdg;

 103          const double cmd = ap.step(s, 0.02);
 104          if (ap.mode() == Mode::AUTO_HEADING && !gotCompletion) {
 105              completionCmd = cmd;      // 机动完成拍的输出
 106              gotCompletion = true;
 107          }
 108          prevCmd = cmd;
 109      }
 110      EXPECT_EQ(ap.mode(), Mode::AUTO_HEADING);  // 完成后回到 AUTO_HEADING
 111      ASSERT_TRUE(gotCompletion);
 112      // P11 整改：完成拍必须输出 PD 闭环结果（经舵速限幅），而非 0 初始值瞬跳。
 113      // 本场景：完成时舵角 15°，完成拍 e=0 进入死区，输出限幅回中 15-0.2=14.8
 114      EXPECT_GT(completionCmd, 0.0);
 115      EXPECT_NEAR(completionCmd, 14.8, 1e-9);
 116      EXPECT_LE(std::abs(completionCmd - 15.0), 10.0 * 0.02 + 1e-9);  // ddMax·dt
 117  }

 142  TEST(AutopilotCore, EscDitherReachesPdGainsAfterBaseline) {
 143      AutopilotCore ap;
 144      // 加快载波便于观察（1 s 周期）
 145      auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 146      tp.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI;
 147      ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 148      ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 149      ap.setHeadingRef(0.0);
 150      SensorInput s{0, 0, 0, 10, 0};
 151  
 152      // 合成 Nomoto 数据驱动在线辨识：±25° Z 形（8/3 拍保持），K=0.2 T=8
 153      // 辨识器每 50 拍（1 s）采样一次，收敛后极点配置建立基线（Kp≈1.6）
 154      const double K = 0.2, T = 8.0;
 155      double r = 0.0;
 156      int hold[2] = {8, 3}; double dval[2] = {25.0, -25.0};
 157      int phase = 0, cnt = 0;
 158      double schedKp = 0.0;
 159      bool baselineSeen = false;
 160      for (int k = 0; k < 400 * 50 && !baselineSeen; ++k) {
 161          if (k % 50 == 0) {  // 每秒推进一次合成激励
 162              const double d = dval[phase];
 163              r = (K * d * 1.0 + T * r) / (1.0 + T);
 164              s.rudderDeg = d;
 165              s.rateDegS = r;
 166              if (++cnt >= hold[phase]) { cnt = 0; phase = 1 - phase; }
 167          }
 168          ap.step(s, 0.02);
 169          const double kpNow = ap.pd().params().Kp;
 170          if (k == 0) schedKp = kpNow;  // 调度表增益（10 kn 海况 0 → 1.2）
 171          // 极点配置目标 Kp = 0.2²·8/0.2 = 1.6，与调度值 1.2 可区分
 172          // （阈值放宽到 ±0.2：同拍窗口结算可能先钳一步 ±10%）
 173          if (std::abs(kpNow - 1.6) < 0.2) baselineSeen = true;
 174      }
 175      ASSERT_TRUE(baselineSeen) << "极点配置基线未建立（schedKp=" << schedKp << "）";
 176      // 基线建立后：一个完整载波周期内，实际增益应覆盖 ±escAmp 相对调制
 177      double mn = 1e9, mx = -1e9;
 178      for (int k = 0; k < 100; ++k) {  // 2 s = 2 个整周期
 179          if (k % 50 == 0) {
 180              const double d = dval[phase];
 181              r = (K * d * 1.0 + T * r) / (1.0 + T);
 182              s.rudderDeg = d;
 183              s.rateDegS = r;
 184              if (++cnt >= hold[phase]) { cnt = 0; phase = 1 - phase; }
 185          }
 186          ap.step(s, 0.02);
 187          const double kpNow = ap.pd().params().Kp;
 188          mn = std::min(mn, kpNow); mx = std::max(mx, kpNow);
 189      }
 190      EXPECT_GT(mx - mn, 0.5 * 2.0 * tp.escAmp * 1.6);  // 至少一半理论峰-峰
 191  }

 215  TEST(AutopilotCore, IdentUpdatesDoNotOverwriteEscGains) {
 216      AutopilotCore ap;
 217      auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 218      tp.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI;   // 1 s 载波：50 拍均值恰好整周期去抖
 219      tp.windowSec = 10.0;       // 缩短 ESC 窗口加快测试
 220      ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 221      ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 222      ap.setHeadingRef(0.0);
 223      SensorInput s{0, 0, 0, 10, 0};
 224  
 225      // 合成 Nomoto 数据驱动在线辨识：±25° Z 形（8/3 拍保持）
 226      double K = 0.2, T = 8.0;
 227      double r = 0.0;
 228      int hold[2] = {8, 3}; double dval[2] = {25.0, -25.0};
 229      int phase = 0, cnt = 0;
 230      auto step1s = [&]() {  // 跑 50 拍（1 s），推进一次合成激励
 231          const double d = dval[phase];
 232          r = (K * d * 1.0 + T * r) / (1.0 + T);
 233          s.rudderDeg = d;
 234          s.rateDegS = r;
 235          if (++cnt >= hold[phase]) { cnt = 0; phase = 1 - phase; }
 236          for (int k = 0; k < 50; ++k) ap.step(s, 0.02);
 237      };
 238      // 50 拍（载波整周期）PD 增益均值 = 去抖后的 ESC 持久增益
 239      auto gainCenter = [&](double& kpC, double& kdC) {
 240          kpC = 0.0; kdC = 0.0;
 241          for (int k = 0; k < 50; ++k) {
 242              ap.step(s, 0.02);
 243              kpC += ap.pd().params().Kp;
 244              kdC += ap.pd().params().Kd;
 245          }
 246          kpC /= 50.0; kdC /= 50.0;
 247      };
 248  
 249      // 阶段1：(K=0.2,T=8) 驱动 200 s，基线链收敛到 placement≈(1.588, 8.30)
 250      for (int sec = 0; sec < 199; ++sec) step1s();
 251      double KpB, KdB;
 252      gainCenter(KpB, KdB);  // 第 200 s
 253      EXPECT_NEAR(KpB, 1.588, 0.10);
 254      EXPECT_NEAR(KdB, 8.30, 0.50);
 255  
 256      // 阶段2：切换 T=12（K 不变），RLS 缓慢再收敛
 257      T = 12.0;
 258      for (int sec = 0; sec < 70; ++sec) step1s();  // t≈270 s
 259      // 检查点1：估计已明显移动（T̂>8.6，较基线估计 +13% 以上），但 25% 阈值未到，
 260      //          增益必须仍钉在旧基线（盲目覆写实现此时已跳到 placement≈(2.0,12+)）
 261      EXPECT_GT(ap.identifier().T(), 8.6) << "辨识未跟上新对象，测试前提不成立";
 262      double Kp1, Kd1;
 263      gainCenter(Kp1, Kd1);
 264      EXPECT_NEAR(Kp1, KpB, 0.06) << "Kp 被辨识更新覆写";
 265      EXPECT_NEAR(Kd1, KdB, 0.40) << "Kd 被辨识更新覆写";
 266  
 267      // 阶段3：继续再收敛，t≈284 s 漂移越阈 → 显式重基线
 268      for (int sec = 0; sec < 118; ++sec) step1s();  // t≈389 s
 269      double Kp2, Kd2;
 270      gainCenter(Kp2, Kd2);
 271      // 增益必须已跳到新 placement≈(2.12, 12.54)（显式重基线路径）
 272      EXPECT_NEAR(Kp2, 2.12, 0.15);
 273      EXPECT_NEAR(Kd2, 12.54, 0.80);
 274      EXPECT_GT(Kd2 - KdB, 3.0) << "未发生显式重基线";
 275  }

 282  TEST(AutopilotCore, EscFallbackRestoresBaselineOnOscillation) {
 283      AutopilotCore ap;
 284      auto tp = ap.tuner().params();
 285      tp.escFreq = 2.0 * M_PI;   // 1 s 载波（50 拍整周期）
 286      tp.windowSec = 10.0;       // 500 拍窗口
 287      ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 288      ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 289      ap.setHeadingRef(0.0);
 290      SensorInput s{0, 0, 0, 10, 0};
 291  
 292      double K = 0.2, T = 8.0;
 293      double r = 0.0;
 294      int hold[2] = {8, 3}; double dval[2] = {25.0, -25.0};
 295      int phase = 0, cnt = 0;
 296      int k0 = -1;              // 基线建立拍（载波相位原点）
 297      double schedKp = 0.0;
 298      long kGlobal = 0;
 299      // 跑 50 拍（1 s）；eFn 为空则 heading=0（e=0），否则按拍注入航向误差
 300      auto run1s = [&](double (*eFn)(long, int)) {
 301          const double d = dval[phase];
 302          r = (K * d * 1.0 + T * r) / (1.0 + T);
 303          s.rudderDeg = d;
 304          s.rateDegS = r;
 305          if (++cnt >= hold[phase]) { cnt = 0; phase = 1 - phase; }
 306          for (int k = 0; k < 50; ++k, ++kGlobal) {
 307              if (eFn) s.headingDeg = -eFn(kGlobal, k0);  // e = -heading（ref=0）
 308              ap.step(s, 0.02);
 309              if (kGlobal == 0) schedKp = ap.pd().params().Kp;
 310              if (k0 < 0 && std::abs(ap.pd().params().Kp - schedKp) > 0.01 * schedKp)
 311                  k0 = kGlobal;  // 首次极点配置接管的拍
 312          }
 313      };
 314      auto gainCenter = [&](double& kpC, double& kdC) {
 315          kpC = 0.0; kdC = 0.0;
 316          for (int k = 0; k < 50; ++k, ++kGlobal) {
 317              ap.step(s, 0.02);
 318              kpC += ap.pd().params().Kp;
 319              kdC += ap.pd().params().Kd;
 320          }
 321          kpC /= 50.0; kdC /= 50.0;
 322      };
 323  
 324      // 阶段1：驱动 200 s 收敛基线（e=0）
 325      for (int sec = 0; sec < 199; ++sec) run1s(nullptr);
 326      ASSERT_GE(k0, 0) << "极点配置基线未建立";
 327      double KpB, KdB;
 328      gainCenter(KpB, KdB);
 329      EXPECT_NEAR(KpB, 1.588, 0.10);
 330      EXPECT_NEAR(KdB, 8.30, 0.50);
 331  
 332      // 阶段2：注入 e = 5-3·sin(载波相位)（恒正 → 振荡检测无过零，幅值保持 0），
 333      //        成本与 Kp 载波负相关 → 梯度使 Kp 上移，更新被接受
 334      for (int sec = 0; sec < 25; ++sec) {
 335          run1s([](long k, int base) {
 336              return 5.0 - 3.0 * std::sin(2.0 * M_PI * static_cast<double>(k - base) / 50.0);
 337          });
 338      }
 339      double KpUp, KdUp;
 340      gainCenter(KpUp, KdUp);
 341      EXPECT_GT(KpUp, KpB * 1.04) << "ESC 未能在稳定门放行时上调 Kp";
 342  
 343      // 阶段3：改注 e = 6·sin(载波相位)（零均值过零振荡，峰-峰 12° > oscMax 5°），

 346          run1s([](long k, int base) {
 347              return 6.0 * std::sin(2.0 * M_PI * static_cast<double>(k - base) / 50.0);
 348          });
 349      }
 350      double KpR, KdR;
 351      gainCenter(KpR, KdR);
 352      EXPECT_NEAR(KpR, KpB, 0.03) << "回退未恢复 Kp 基线";
 353      EXPECT_NEAR(KdR, KdB, 0.20) << "回退未恢复 Kd 基线";
 354  }

 357  TEST(AutopilotCore, OscDetectorStarvedDuringReferenceMotion) {
 358      AutopilotCore ap;
 359      ap.setMode(Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 360      SensorInput s{0, 0, 0, 10, 0};
 361      // 参考每 15 s 翻转（--esc Z 形节拍），航向误差 ±8° 摆动：
 362      // 若检测器照常喂入，幅值会顶到 16° 并锁死稳定门
 363      double maxAmp = 0.0;
 364      for (int k = 0; k < 60 * 50; ++k) {  // 60 s
 365          ap.setHeadingRef((k / 750) % 2 == 0 ? 40.0 : -40.0);
 366          s.headingDeg = 8.0 * std::sin(2.0 * M_PI * k / 250.0);
 367          ap.step(s, 0.02);
 368          maxAmp = std::max(maxAmp, ap.tuner().oscDetector().amplitude());
 369      }
 370      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(maxAmp, 0.0);  // 参考机动期间检测器不喂入
 371      // 参考稳定 30 s 后恢复喂入：±8° 摆动的峰-峰幅值 ≈16°
 372      ap.setHeadingRef(0.0);
 373      for (int k = 0; k < 45 * 50; ++k) {
 374          s.headingDeg = 8.0 * std::sin(2.0 * M_PI * k / 250.0);
 375          ap.step(s, 0.02);
 376      }
 377      EXPECT_GT(ap.tuner().oscDetector().amplitude(), 8.0);
 378  }
