 401  TEST(AutopilotCore, IdentTrialIdentifiesAndAppliesGains) {
 402      AutopilotCore ap;
 403      ap.scheduleMut().setTable({{0.0, 100.0, 0, 1.0, 0.5}});  // 未标定冷启动
 404      auto tp = ap.tuner().params(); tp.highSpeedDeactivateKn = -1.0;  // 无 ESC 载波
 405      ap.setTunerParams(tp);
 406      ap.startIdentifyTrial(20.0, 20.0, 4);
 407      EXPECT_EQ(ap.mode(), Mode::AUTO_MANEUVER);
 408      EXPECT_EQ(ap.identTrialState(), IdentTrialState::RUNNING);
 409      // 用 K=0.2/T=8 的 Nomoto 模型当船（与 sim/nomoto_plant.hpp 相同方程）
 410      double r = 0.0, psi = 0.0, deltaAct = 0.0;
 411      for (int k = 0; k < 300 * 50 && ap.identTrialState() == IdentTrialState::RUNNING; ++k) {
 412          SensorInput s{psi, r, deltaAct, 10.0, 0};
 413          const double cmd = ap.step(s, 0.02);
 414          double ddot = (cmd - deltaAct) / 0.3;
 415          ddot = std::clamp(ddot, -10.0, 10.0);
 416          deltaAct = std::clamp(deltaAct + ddot * 0.02, -35.0, 35.0);
 417          r += (0.2 * deltaAct - r) / 8.0 * 0.02;
 418          psi += r * 0.02;
 419      }
 420      ASSERT_EQ(ap.identTrialState(), IdentTrialState::OK);
 421      EXPECT_TRUE(ap.identifier().valid());
 422      EXPECT_NEAR(ap.identifier().K(), 0.2, 0.05);
 423      EXPECT_NEAR(ap.identifier().T(), 8.0, 2.0);
 424      // 试验后增益 = 极点配置 (ζ=0.85, ωn=0.2)：Kp=ωn²T/K=1.6，Kd=(2ζωnT−1)/K=8.6
 425      EXPECT_NEAR(ap.pd().params().Kp, 1.6, 0.8);
 426      EXPECT_NEAR(ap.pd().params().Kd, 8.6, 4.0);
 427      EXPECT_EQ(ap.mode(), Mode::AUTO_HEADING);
 428  }

   9  static ManeuverSequencer::Cmd step(ManeuverSequencer& s, double& hdg, double rate, double dt) {
  10      // 简单积分航向
  11      hdg += rate * dt;
  12      while (hdg > 180.0) hdg -= 360.0;
  13      while (hdg <= -180.0) hdg += 360.0;
  14      return s.update(hdg, rate, dt);

  51  TEST(ManeuverSequencer, ZigzagStructure) {
  52      auto legs = ManeuverSequencer::zigzag(0.0, 10.0, 15.0, 3);
  53      ASSERT_EQ(legs.size(), 6u);

  57          // P12：阈值带符号且与本段舵向一致，符号交替
  58          const double expect = (i % 2 == 0) ? 15.0 : -15.0;
  59          EXPECT_NEAR(legs[i].threshold, expect, 1e-9) << "leg " << i;
  60          EXPECT_GT(legs[i].target * legs[i].threshold, 0.0) << "leg " << i << " 阈值符号须与舵向一致";
  61      }
  62      EXPECT_GT(legs[0].target, 0.0);
  63      EXPECT_LT(legs[1].target, 0.0);
  64  }

  94  TEST(ManeuverSequencer, CloverleafLegsAreGeometricallyConsistent) {
  95      // 几何整改回归：四个转向段同向，直航段目标 = 前一段出转航向，
  96      // 总转向 4×270° = 1080°，净航向回 ψ0（四叶闭合）
  97      for (double psi0 : {0.0, 40.0, -120.0}) {
  98          auto legs = ManeuverSequencer::cloverleaf(psi0, 30.0, 20.0);
  99          ASSERT_EQ(legs.size(), 8u);
 100          double hdg = psi0;      // 理想船期望航向（无超调）
 101          double totalTurn = 0.0;
 102          for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
 103              const Leg& l = legs[i];
 104              EXPECT_EQ(l.next, (i < 7) ? (i + 1) : -1) << "leg " << i;
 105              if (l.mode == Leg::Mode::RUDDER) {
 106                  EXPECT_GT(l.target, 0.0) << "turn leg " << i << " 四段转向必须同向(+)";
 107                  const double dpsi = l.threshold;  // P12：阈值带符号，直接即航向增量
 108                  hdg = normalizeAngleDeg(hdg + dpsi);
 109                  totalTurn += dpsi;
 110              } else {
 111                  // 直航段目标航向必须等于上一段出转后的实际航向
 112                  EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(l.target, hdg), 0.0, 1e-9)
 113                      << "straight leg " << i << " psi0=" << psi0;
 114              }
 115          }
 116          EXPECT_NEAR(totalTurn, 1080.0, 1e-9) << "psi0=" << psi0;
 117          EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(hdg, psi0), 0.0, 1e-9) << "psi0=" << psi0;
 118          // 四个直航目标互不相同（四叶指向四个不同方向）
 119          std::set<int> targets;
 120          for (int i = 1; i < 8; i += 2)
 121              targets.insert(static_cast<int>(std::lround(legs[i].target)));
 122          EXPECT_EQ(targets.size(), 4u) << "psi0=" << psi0;
 123      }
 124      // dMax 取负：整体镜像为左转四叶，几何同样自洽
 125      auto legsL = ManeuverSequencer::cloverleaf(10.0, 30.0, -20.0);
 126      double hdg = 10.0, totalTurn = 0.0;
 127      for (const Leg& l : legsL) {
 128          if (l.mode == Leg::Mode::RUDDER) {
 129              EXPECT_LT(l.target, 0.0);
 130              EXPECT_LT(l.threshold, 0.0);  // P12：左转段阈值为负，与舵向一致
 131              const double dpsi = l.threshold;
 132              hdg = normalizeAngleDeg(hdg + dpsi);
 133              totalTurn += dpsi;
 134          } else {
 135              EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(l.target, hdg), 0.0, 1e-9);
 136          }
 137      }
 138      EXPECT_NEAR(totalTurn, -1080.0, 1e-9);
 139      EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(hdg, 10.0), 0.0, 1e-9);
 140  }

 142  TEST(ManeuverSequencer, CloverleafGeometryClosesWithIdealShip) {
 143      // 几何整改回归：用理想化航向模型走完整序列——
 144      //   RUDDER 段：按舵角符号以恒速率转向；HEADING 段：一阶趋近目标航向。
 145      // 验证按段顺序推进、切段时航向与计划出段航向连续、
 146      // 累计航向变化 ≈ +1080°（四叶）、末段结束后航向回 ψ0。
 147      const double psi0 = 30.0;
 148      auto legs = ManeuverSequencer::cloverleaf(psi0, 5.0, 20.0);
 149      ASSERT_EQ(legs.size(), 8u);
 150      // 计划进段航向：转向段出口 += sign(δ)·270°，直航段不变
 151      std::vector<double> planEntry = {psi0};
 152      for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < legs.size(); ++i) {
 153          double exitH = planEntry.back();
 154          if (legs[i].mode == Leg::Mode::RUDDER)
 155              exitH += legs[i].threshold;  // P12：阈值带符号，直接即计划航向增量
 156          planEntry.push_back(normalizeAngleDeg(exitH));
 157      }
 158  
 159      ManeuverSequencer s;
 160      s.setLegs(legs);
 161      const double dt = 0.1, maxRate = 3.0;
 162      double hdg = psi0, lastH = psi0, cumHdg = 0.0, rate = 0.0;
 163      ManeuverSequencer::Cmd cmd{false, 0.0, 0.0};
 164      std::vector<int> visitOrder = {0};
 165      for (int k = 0; k < 20000 && !s.done(); ++k) {
 166          hdg = normalizeAngleDeg(hdg + rate * dt);   // 理想船积分航向
 167          cumHdg += angleDiffDeg(hdg, lastH);
 168          lastH = hdg;
 169          const int prev = s.currentIndex();
 170          cmd = s.update(hdg, rate, dt);
 171          if (s.currentIndex() != prev && !s.done()) {  // 切段：航向须与计划进段航向连续
 172              const int cur = s.currentIndex();
 173              visitOrder.push_back(cur);
 174              ASSERT_LT(cur, (int)planEntry.size());
 175              EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(planEntry[cur], hdg), 0.0, 1.5)
 176                  << "enter leg " << cur;
 177              if (legs[cur].mode == Leg::Mode::HEADING)
 178                  EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(legs[cur].target, hdg), 0.0, 1.5)
 179                      << "straight target mismatch at leg " << cur;
 180          }
 181          if (cmd.isHeading) {                        // 一阶趋近目标航向
 182              const double diff = angleDiffDeg(cmd.heading, hdg);
 183              rate = std::max(-maxRate, std::min(maxRate, 2.0 * diff));
 184          } else {                                    // 恒舵角 → 恒转向率
 185              rate = (cmd.rudder > 0.0) ? maxRate : -maxRate;
 186          }
 187      }
 188      EXPECT_TRUE(s.done());
 189      EXPECT_EQ(visitOrder, (std::vector<int>{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7}));
 190      EXPECT_NEAR(cumHdg, 1080.0, 8.0);               // 四叶总航向变化
 191      EXPECT_NEAR(angleDiffDeg(hdg, psi0), 0.0, 1.5); // 净回 ψ0，图案闭合
 192  }

 248  TEST(ManeuverSequencer, HeadingReachedIsDirectionAware) {
 249      // P12 整改回归：反舵段的顺漂预触发。
 250      // 段1 右舵转 +30°；段2 反舵、阈值 -20°。进入段2 后船因惯性仍沿旧方向
 251      // 顺漂（cumHeading 继续正向增长，甚至远超 |-20°|），触发器不得切段；
 252      // 直到船真正反向、累计航向变化过 -20° 才允许切段。
 253      ManeuverSequencer s;
 254      std::vector<Leg> legs = {
 255          {Leg::Mode::RUDDER, +20.0, Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED, +30.0, 1},
 256          {Leg::Mode::RUDDER, -20.0, Leg::Trigger::HEADING_REACHED, -20.0, 2},
 257          {Leg::Mode::HEADING, 0.0, Leg::Trigger::NONE, 0.0, -1},
 258      };
 259      s.setLegs(legs);
 260      double hdg = 0.0;
 261      const double dt = 0.1;
 262      // 段1：+5°/s 右转，累计 +30° 后切到段2
 263      for (int k = 0; k < 200 && s.currentIndex() == 0; ++k) step(s, hdg, 5.0, dt);
 264      ASSERT_EQ(s.currentIndex(), 1);
 265      const double hdgAtLeg2Entry = hdg;  // ≈ +30°
 266      // 顺漂阶段：舵已反，航向仍 +5°/s 增长 8 s（累计 +40°。
 267      // 旧逻辑 |cum|>=|thr| 在顺漂 +20° 时就会误切段）
 268      for (int k = 0; k < 80; ++k) {
 269          step(s, hdg, 5.0, dt);
 270          ASSERT_EQ(s.currentIndex(), 1) << "顺漂阶段不得触发（k=" << k << "）";
 271      }
 272      // 船真正反向：-5°/s，从 +40° 回摆，净变化过 -20° 后应切段
 273      bool advanced = false;
 274      for (int k = 0; k < 300 && !advanced; ++k) {
 275          step(s, hdg, -5.0, dt);
 276          if (s.currentIndex() == 2) {
 277              advanced = true;
 278              // 切段点相对段2入口的真实航向变化必须已达 -20°（容差一步 0.5°）
 279              EXPECT_LE(angleDiffDeg(hdg, hdgAtLeg2Entry), -19.5);
 280          }
 281      }
 282      EXPECT_TRUE(advanced) << "真正反向过阈值后必须切段";
 283  }

  80  TEST(NomotoIdentifier, RecoversAfterNaNInput) {
  81      NomotoIdentifier::Params p;
  82      p.lambda = 0.98; p.p0 = 1.0;
  83      p.rMin = 0.1; p.deltaMin = 2.0; p.drMin = 0.2;
  84      NomotoIdentifier id(p), ref(p);
  85      const double K = 0.2, T = 8.0, dt = 1.0;
  86      double r = 0.0;
  87      int hold[2] = {8, 3}; double dval[2] = {25.0, -25.0};
  88      int phase = 0, cnt = 0;
  89      const double NaN = std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
  90      for (int k = 0; k < 400; ++k) {
  91          double d = dval[phase];
  92          r = nomotoStep(K, T, d, r, dt);
  93          // 参考辨识器：全程干净数据
  94          ref.update(d, r, dt);
  95          // 被测辨识器：第 200 拍注入单拍 NaN（舵角与转向率各来一次）
  96          if (k == 200) { id.update(NaN, NaN, dt); }
  97          else          { id.update(d, r, dt); }
  98          if (++cnt >= hold[phase]) { cnt = 0; phase = 1 - phase; }
  99      }
 100      // 恢复：结果有限、物理合理，且与无 NaN 参考运行相当
 101      EXPECT_TRUE(id.excited());
 102      EXPECT_TRUE(id.valid());
 103      EXPECT_TRUE(std::isfinite(id.K()));
 104      EXPECT_TRUE(std::isfinite(id.T()));
 105      EXPECT_NEAR(id.K(), ref.K(), 0.02);
 106      EXPECT_NEAR(id.T(), ref.T(), 1.0);
 107  }

  96      std::vector<uint8_t> storage(4096, 0);
  97      auto readFn = [&](uint8_t* buf, size_t len) -> bool {
  98          std::memcpy(buf, storage.data(), std::min(len, storage.size()));
  99          return true;
 100      };
 101      auto writeFn = [&](const uint8_t* buf, size_t len) -> bool {
 102          if (len > storage.size()) storage.resize(len);
 103          std::memcpy(storage.data(), buf, len);
 104          return true;
 105      };
 106      uint32_t fakeClock = 1000;
 107      auto clockFn = [&]() -> uint32_t { return fakeClock; };
 108  
 109      ParamStore store(readFn, writeFn, clockFn);
 110      auto p = makeSample();
 111      ASSERT_TRUE(store.save(p));
 112      EXPECT_EQ(p.timestamp, 1000);  // 自动填时间戳
 113      EXPECT_EQ(p.version, 6u);     // 版本号 +1
 114  
 115      ControlParams q;
 116      ASSERT_TRUE(store.load(q));
 117      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(q.K, p.K);
 118      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(q.Kd, p.Kd);
 119      EXPECT_EQ(q.version, 6u);
 120      EXPECT_EQ(q.timestamp, 1000u);
 121      EXPECT_TRUE(q.verifyCrc());
 122      EXPECT_TRUE(q.validateRange());
 123  }

  65  TEST(PdController, LowpassAttenuation) {
  66      // 叠加 5 Hz 噪声，微分分量应显著衰减（> 80%）
  67      // 对比有滤波(tau=0.2)与无滤波(tau≈0)两种控制器的微分贡献
  68      auto pf = defaultParams(); pf.Kp = 0.0; pf.Kd = 1.0; pf.tau = 0.2; pf.ddMax = 1e6; pf.dMax = 1e6;
  69      auto pu = pf; pu.tau = 1e-6;  // 几乎无滤波
  70      PdController pdf(pf), pdu(pu);
  71      double sumF = 0.0, sumU = 0.0;
  72      for (int k = 0; k < 200; ++k) {
  73          double e = 1.0 + 0.5 * std::sin(2 * M_PI * 5 * k * pf.dt);  // 5 Hz 噪声
  74          double of = pdf.update(e, 0.0);   // Kp=0，out 即微分贡献
  75          double ou = pdu.update(e, 0.0);
  76          sumF += std::abs(of);
  77          sumU += std::abs(ou);
  78      }
  79      // 滤波后微分贡献应 < 无滤波的 20%（衰减 > 80%）
  80      EXPECT_LT(sumF, 0.2 * sumU);
  81  }

  84  TEST(PdController, SetGainsPreservesState) {
  85      auto p = defaultParams();
  86      p.Kp = 1.0; p.Kd = 0.0; p.ddMax = 1000.0; p.dMax = 100.0;  // 关闭微分与限幅干扰
  87      PdController pd(p);
  88      (void)pd.update(10.0, 0.0);  // 建立历史
  89      // setGains 不应清空 prevErr_，下一拍微分应基于上一拍误差
  90      pd.setGains(2.0, 0.5);
  91      (void)pd.update(10.0, 0.0);  // e 恒为 10，deriv 应为 0（e 未变）
  92      // 改用 Kd>0 + 变化 e 验证状态保留
  93      pd.reset();
  94      (void)pd.update(10.0, 0.0);
  95      pd.setGains(1.0, 1.0);
  96      double out2 = pd.update(11.0, 0.0);  // e 从 10→11，deriv=(1)/0.02=50（带低通）
  97      // 状态保留时 prevErr_=10，derivRaw=(11-10)/0.02=50；若被清 first_=true 则 deriv=0
  98      EXPECT_GT(out2, 1.0 * 11.0);  // 微分项有贡献
  99  }

 112      EXPECT_GT(out2, 19.0);               // 明确不是从 0 爬升

 116  TEST(PdController, DeadzoneExitRespectsRateLimit) {
 117      auto p = defaultParams();
 118      p.Kp = 10.0; p.ddMax = 10.0; p.dMax = 35.0;  // ddMax*dt = 0.2°/拍
 119      PdController pd(p);
 120      // 先把输出跑到大舵角（误差 30°，持续至限幅饱和）
 121      double prev = 0.0;
 122      for (int k = 0; k < 300; ++k) prev = pd.update(30.0, 0.0);
 123      EXPECT_NEAR(prev, 35.0, 1e-9);  // 已到正限幅
 124      // 误差突然进入死区：输出应经舵速限幅逐拍回中，|Δ| ≤ 0.2°/拍
 125      double out = prev;
 126      for (int k = 0; k < 300 && out != 0.0; ++k) {
 127          double next = pd.update(0.1, 0.0);  // |e|=0.1 < deadzone 0.3
 128          EXPECT_LE(std::abs(next - out), 0.2 + 1e-9)
 129              << "beat " << k << ": 死区回中跳变超限 " << out << " -> " << next;
 130          out = next;
 131      }
 132      EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ(out, 0.0);  // 最终回到 0
 133  }

 168  TEST(TunerDebugApi, SettleWindowOnceAcceptsOrReverts) {
 169      AutoTuner t;
 170      TunerDebugApi api(t);
 171      ASSERT_TRUE(api.establishBaseline(K_SHIP, T_SHIP));
 172      api.forceEnabled(true);
 173      for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) api.accumulateOnce(1.0, 2.0, true);
 174      const double kpBefore = api.snapshot().curKp;
 175      // 辨识估计有效：裁决后 curKp 被持久化（或回退到基线），窗口被清空
 176      api.settleWindowOnce(true, K_SHIP, T_SHIP);
 177      auto s = api.snapshot();
 178      EXPECT_EQ(s.windowSamples, 0u);
 179      EXPECT_TRUE(s.baselineEstablished);
 180      // 强制注入必过门的坏增益（Kp 极大 → 带宽超上限），裁决应回退基线
 181      api.forceGains(1e6, 1e6);
 182      api.forceGradient(1e6, 1e6);
 183      for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) api.accumulateOnce(1.0, 1.0, true);
 184      api.settleWindowOnce(true, K_SHIP, T_SHIP);
 185      s = api.snapshot();
 186      EXPECT_LT(s.curKp, 100.0);  // 被稳定门拦下并回退，而非接受 1e6 级增益
 187      (void)kpBefore;
 188  }

  41  def load_csv(path):
  42      data = {c: [] for c in COLUMNS}
  43      with open(path, newline="") as f:
  44          reader = csv.reader(f)
  45          header = next(reader, None)
  46          if header is None:
  47              raise ValueError(f"{path}: 空 CSV")
  48          header = [h.strip() for h in header]
  49          idx_map = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(header)}
  50          for row in reader:
  51              if not row or len(row) < len(COLUMNS):
  52                  continue
  53              for c in COLUMNS:
  54                  if c not in idx_map:
  55                      continue
  56                  v = row[idx_map[c]]
  57                  try:
  58                      data[c].append(int(float(v)) if c == "mode" else float(v))
  59                  except ValueError:
  60                      data[c].append(0.0)
  61      return {c: np.array(data[c]) for c in COLUMNS}

  70  def animate(data, out_path, fps=30, speed=1.0, polar=False, title=""):

  74      total_dur = t[-1] - t[0] if n > 1 else 0.0
  75      target_frames = max(30, min(int(fps * total_dur / max(speed, 0.01)), 1200))
  76      stride = max(1, n // target_frames)

 151      def init():
 152          for ln in (line_psi, line_ref, line_cmd, line_act, line_rate, line_err, line_kp, line_kd):

 159          return []

 161      def update(frame):
 162          i = frame + 1
 163          if i > n:
 164              i = n
 165          xs = t[:i]
 166          line_psi.set_data(xs, data["heading"][idx[:i]])
 167          line_ref.set_data(xs, data["headingRef"][idx[:i]])
 168          head_dot.set_data([t[i-1]], [data["heading"][idx[i-1]]])
 169          line_cmd.set_data(xs, data["rudderCmd"][idx[:i]])
 170          line_act.set_data(xs, data["rudderAct"][idx[:i]])
 171          line_rate.set_data(xs, data["rate"][idx[:i]])
 172          line_err.set_data(xs, data["error"][idx[:i]])
 173          line_kp.set_data(xs, data["Kp"][idx[:i]])
 174          line_kd.set_data(xs, data["Kd"][idx[:i]])
 175          if polar:
 176              psi = np.deg2rad(data["heading"][idx[:i]])
 177              dpsi = np.abs(np.diff(data["heading"][idx[:i]], prepend=data["heading"][idx[0]]))
 178              r = np.cumsum(dpsi)
 179              polar_line.set_data(psi, r)
 180              polar_dot.set_data([psi[-1]], [r[-1]])
 181          time_text.set_text(f"t = {t[i-1]:.2f} s")
 182          return []
 183  
 184      anim = FuncAnimation(fig, update, frames=n, init_func=init,
 185                           interval=1000.0 / fps, blit=False, repeat=False)
 186      writer = pick_writer(out_path)
 187      anim.save(out_path, writer=writer, dpi=110)
 188      plt.close(fig)
 189      return out_path

 192  def main():
 193      ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="自动舵闭环仿真动画生成")
 194      ap.add_argument("csv", help="ar_sim 导出的 CSV 路径")
 195      ap.add_argument("-o", "--out", required=True, help="输出视频路径（.mp4 或 .gif）")
 196      ap.add_argument("--fps", type=int, default=30, help="帧率（默认 30）")
 197      ap.add_argument("--speed", type=float, default=1.0, help="回放速度倍数（>1 加速）")
 198      ap.add_argument("--polar", action="store_true", help="右侧追加机动极坐标轨迹")
 199      ap.add_argument("--title", default="", help="视频标题")
 200      args = ap.parse_args()
 201  
 202      if not Path(args.csv).exists():
 203          sys.exit(f"CSV 不存在: {args.csv}")
 204      data = load_csv(args.csv)
 205      if len(data["t"]) < 2:
 206          sys.exit("CSV 采样点不足")
 207  
 208      print(f"生成动画: {args.csv} → {args.out} (fps={args.fps}, speed={args.speed}x, polar={args.polar})")
 209      animate(data, args.out, fps=args.fps, speed=args.speed,
 210              polar=args.polar, title=args.title)
 211      print(f"视频已保存: {args.out}")

  11  gen() {
  12      local name="$1"; shift

  19      if [ ! -f "$mp4" ]; then

 171  def main():
 172      ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="自动调参收敛效果图")

 175                      help="输出目录（缺省 docs/auto_tuning/figures）")

  41  def load_csv(path):
  42      data = {c: [] for c in COLUMNS}
  43      with open(path, newline="") as f:
  44          reader = csv.reader(f)
  45          header = next(reader, None)
  46          if header is None:
  47              raise ValueError(f"{path}: 空 CSV")
  48          header = [h.strip() for h in header]
  49          idx_map = {h: i for i, h in enumerate(header)}
  50          for row in reader:
  51              if not row or len(row) < len(COLUMNS):
  52                  continue
  53              for c in COLUMNS:
  54                  if c not in idx_map:
  55                      continue
  56                  v = row[idx_map[c]]
  57                  try:
  58                      data[c].append(int(float(v)) if c == "mode" else float(v))
  59                  except ValueError:
  60                      data[c].append(0.0)
  61      return {c: np.array(data[c]) for c in COLUMNS}

  64  def compute_metrics(data):
  65      t, psi, ref, err = data["t"], data["heading"], data["headingRef"], data["error"]
  66      step_deg = float(np.max(np.abs(np.diff(ref)))) if len(ref) > 1 else 0.0
  67      if step_deg > 1e-6:
  68          idx_step = int(np.argmax(np.abs(np.diff(ref)))) + 1
  69          post = psi[idx_step:]
  70          target = ref[idx_step] if idx_step < len(ref) else 0.0
  71          if len(post) and abs(target) > 1e-6:
  72              overshoot = (np.max(post) - target) if target >= 0 else (target - np.min(post))
  73              overshoot_pct = overshoot / abs(target) * 100.0
  74          else:
  75              overshoot_pct = 0.0
  76          band = 0.05 * step_deg
  77          settle = 0.0
  78          for ti, ei in zip(t, err):
  79              if abs(ei) > band:
  80                  settle = float(ti)
  81      else:
  82          overshoot_pct, settle = 0.0, 0.0
  83      if len(t) > 1:
  84          mask = t >= t[-1] - 20.0
  85          ess = float(np.std(err[mask])) if mask.sum() > 1 else 0.0
  86      else:
  87          ess = 0.0
  88      cmd = data["rudderCmd"]
  89      if len(cmd) > 1 and (t[-1] - t[0]) > 0:
  90          freq = int(np.sum((cmd[:-1] * cmd[1:]) < 0)) * 60.0 / (t[-1] - t[0])
  91      else:
  92          freq = 0.0
  93      return {"overshoot_pct": overshoot_pct, "settle_s": settle,
  94              "ess_1sigma": ess, "rudder_freq": freq}

 202  def plot_polar(data, ax=None, color=None, label=""):
 203      psi = np.deg2rad(data["heading"])
 204      dpsi = np.abs(np.diff(data["heading"], prepend=data["heading"][0]))
 205      r = np.cumsum(dpsi)
 206      if ax is None:
 207          fig = plt.gcf()
 208          ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection="polar")
 209      ax.plot(psi, r, color=color or "C0", lw=1.2, label=label or "轨迹")
 210      ax.scatter([psi[0]], [r[0]], color="g", s=40, zorder=5, label="起点")
 211      ax.scatter([psi[-1]], [r[-1]], color="r", s=40, zorder=5, label="终点")
 212      ax.set_theta_zero_location("N"); ax.set_theta_direction(-1)
 213      ax.set_title("机动轨迹极坐标（θ=航向, r=累计转首角）", pad=15)
 214      ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=8, bbox_to_anchor=(1.15, 0.0))
 215      return ax

 223  def main():
 224      ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="自动舵闭环仿真结果可视化")
 225      ap.add_argument("csv", nargs="+", help="ar_sim 导出的 CSV 路径（可多个）")
 226      ap.add_argument("-o", "--out", help="输出图片路径；不指定则弹窗显示")
 227      ap.add_argument("--polar", action="store_true", help="追加机动极坐标轨迹图")
 228      ap.add_argument("--no-multipane", action="store_true", help="不画多子图")
 229      ap.add_argument("--grid", action="store_true", help="多文件网格平铺")
 230      ap.add_argument("--metrics", action="store_true", help="打印指标表")
 231      ap.add_argument("--title", default="", help="图总标题")
 232      args = ap.parse_args()
 233  
 234      paths = [Path(p) for p in args.csv]
 235      for p in paths:
 236          if not p.exists():
 237              sys.exit(f"CSV 不存在: {p}")
 238  
 239      datasets = [load_csv(p) for p in paths]
 240      labels = [p.stem for p in paths]
 241      colors = [f"C{i}" for i in range(len(datasets))]
 242      n = len(datasets)
 243  
 244      if args.metrics:
 245          m = {labels[i]: compute_metrics(datasets[i]) for i in range(n)}
 246          print_metrics_table(m)
 247  
 248      if args.grid and n > 1:
 249          ncols = min(2, n); nrows = (n + ncols - 1) // ncols
 250          fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7 * ncols, 4 * nrows))
 251          fig.suptitle(args.title or f"自动舵仿真对比 ({n} 场景)", fontsize=12)
 252          for i, (data, lab, c) in enumerate(zip(datasets, labels, colors)):
 253              ax = plt.subplot(nrows, ncols, i + 1)
 254              t = data["t"]
 255              ax.plot(t, data["heading"], c, lw=1.0, label=f"{lab} ψ")
 256              ax.plot(t, data["headingRef"], "k--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, label="ψ_ref")
 257              ax.set_title(lab, fontsize=9); ax.set_xlabel("时间 (s)"); ax.set_ylabel("°")
 258              ax.grid(alpha=0.3); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
 259      elif not args.no_multipane:
 260          if n == 1:
 261              fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 10))
 262              plot_multipane(datasets[0], title=args.title or f"自动舵闭环仿真 — {labels[0]}")
 263          else:
 264              fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 11))
 265              plot_multipane_overlay(datasets, colors, labels,
 266                                      title=args.title or f"自动舵仿真叠加对比 ({n} 场景)")
 267  
 268      if args.polar:
 269          if n == 1 and not args.no_multipane:
 270              fig2 = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
 271              plot_polar(datasets[0], label=labels[0])
 272          else:
 273              fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
 274              ax = None
 275              for data, c, lab in zip(datasets, colors, labels):
 276                  ax = plot_polar(data, ax=ax, color=c, label=lab)
 277  
 278      if args.out:
 279          if args.polar and (n == 1 and not args.no_multipane):
 280              plt.figure(1); plt.savefig(args.out, dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight")
 281              print(f"多子图已保存: {args.out}")
 282              plt.figure(2); polar_out = _polar_path(args.out)
 283              plt.savefig(polar_out, dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight")
 284              print(f"极坐标图已保存: {polar_out}")
 285          else:
 286              plt.savefig(args.out, dpi=120, bbox_inches="tight")
 287              print(f"图已保存: {args.out}")
 288      else:
 289          plt.show()

  62      # ========== 组 1：层2 极点配置与稳定门 ==========
  63      print("[组1] 极点配置 / 稳定门")
  64      f = c.fields("pole 0.2 8")
  65      check("pole 默认值 Kp=1.6 Kd=8.6",
  66            abs(f["Kp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6 and abs(f["Kd"] - 8.6) < 1e-6, str(f))
  67      f = c.fields("pole 0.2 8 1.0 0.25")
  68      check("pole 自定义 ζ=1.0 ωn=0.25 → Kp=2.5 Kd=15",
  69            abs(f["Kp"] - 2.5) < 1e-6 and abs(f["Kd"] - 15.0) < 1e-6, str(f))
  70      r = c.cmd("pole 0 8")
  71      check("pole 退化输入拒绝", r.startswith("ERR"), r)
  72      check("check 标称过门", c.fields("check 0.2 8 1.6 8.6 0")["pass"] == 1)
  73      check("check Kp<0 拒绝", c.fields("check 0.2 8 -1.6 8.6 0")["pass"] == 0)
  74      check("check 带宽超限拒绝", c.fields("check 0.2 8 100 8.6 0")["pass"] == 0)
  75      check("check 低阻尼拒绝", c.fields("check 0.2 8 1.6 0 0")["pass"] == 0)
  76      check("check 振荡超限拒绝", c.fields("check 0.2 8 1.6 8.6 6")["pass"] == 0)
  77  
  78      # ========== 组 2：基线管理 ==========
  79      print("[组2] 基线管理")
  80      check("baseline 建立", c.fields("baseline 0.2 8")["established"] == 1)
  81      s = c.fields("status")
  82      check("status 基线一致", abs(s["baseKp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6 and abs(s["baseK"]) - 0.2 < 1e-9, str(s))
  83      check("eval 漂移 10% 在阈值内拒绝", c.fields("eval 0.22 8.8 0 1 0")["accepted"] == 0)
  84      check("eval 漂移 40% 超阈值接受", c.fields("eval 0.28 11.2 0 1 0")["accepted"] == 1)
  85      s = c.fields("status")
  86      check("重基线后 baseK=0.28 且梯度清零", abs(s["baseK"] - 0.28) < 1e-9 and s["gradKp"] == 0.0, str(s))
  87      r = c.cmd("baseline 0 8")
  88      check("baseline 退化 K 拒绝", "established=0" in r, r)
  89      c.cmd("baseline 0.2 8")  # 恢复标准基线供后续组使用
  90  
  91      # ========== 组 3：ESC 各环节 ==========
  92      print("[组3] ESC 载波/累积/结算/裁决/限幅")
  93      f = c.fields("dither 1 1")  # enabled_=false（reset 后未开）
  94      check("dither 未开 enabled 不动", f["Kp"] == 1.0 and f["Kd"] == 1.0, str(f))
  95      c.cmd("forceenabled 1")
  96      f = c.fields("dither 1 1")  # phase=0 → sin=0, cos=1
  97      check("dither 相位0: Kp 不变 Kd+5%", abs(f["Kp"] - 1.0) < 1e-9 and abs(f["Kd"] - 1.05) < 1e-9, str(f))
  98      c.cmd("forcephase 1.5707963267948966")  # π/2
  99      f = c.fields("dither 1 1")
 100      check("dither 相位π/2: Kp+5% Kd 不变", abs(f["Kp"] - 1.05) < 1e-9 and abs(f["Kd"] - 1.0) < 1e-6, str(f))
 101      c.cmd("forcephase 0")
 102      for k in range(600):  # 600 拍 e=3°·sin(2πk/1000), δ=1.5（相位保持 0 → 全部进 Kd 通道）
 103          c.cmd(f"accum {3.0 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * k / 1000.0):.4f} 1.5 1")
 104      s = c.fields("status")
 105      check("accum 600 拍入窗", s["samples"] == 600 and s["demodN"] == 600, str(s))
 106      check("demod 单通道: demodKp=0 demodKd>0", s["demodKp"] == 0.0 and s["demodKd"] > 40.0, str(s))
 107      j = c.fields("j")["J"]
 108      check("J 累积为正且量级合理", 100.0 < j < 130.0, f"J={j}")
 109      f = c.fields("step 1.6 8.6")
 110      check("step 梯度下降: Kd 减小、Kp 不变", f["Kd"] < 8.6 and abs(f["Kp"] - 1.6) < 1e-9, str(f))
 111      check("step 限幅内", 8.6 - f["Kd"] <= 0.86 + 1e-9, str(f))
 112      s = c.fields("status")
 113      check("step 后窗口清空", s["samples"] == 0 and s["demodN"] == 0, str(s))
 114      f = c.fields("settle 1 0.2 8")
 115      check("settle 接受路径: 增益持久化", abs(f["curKp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6 and f["curKd"] < 8.6, str(f))
 116      c.cmd("forcegains 1000000 1000000")
 117      c.cmd("forcegrad 1000000 1000000")
 118      for _ in range(10):
 119          c.cmd("accum 1.0 1.0 1")
 120      f = c.fields("settle 1 0.2 8")
 121      check("settle 回退路径: 坏增益被拦下", f["curKp"] < 100.0, str(f))
 122      check("clamp 比例上限", abs(c.fields("clamp 5.0 1.0")["value"] - 1.1) < 1e-9)
 123      check("clamp 绝对下限防锁死", abs(c.fields("clamp 1.0 0.0")["value"] - 1e-3) < 1e-12)
 124

 126      print("[组4] 振荡检测")
 127      c.cmd("oscreset")

 129          e = 2.0 if (i // 50) % 2 == 0 else -2.0

 133      c.cmd("oscreset")

 171      print("[组7] 强制注入")
 172      c.cmd("baseline 0.2 8")
 173      c.cmd("forcegains -1 999")
 174      s = c.fields("status")
 175      check("forcegains 旁路稳定门", s["curKp"] == -1.0 and s["curKd"] == 999.0, str(s))
 176      check("forcegains 不污染基线", abs(s["baseKp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6, str(s))
 177      f = c.fields("revert")
 178      check("revert 恢复", abs(f["Kp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6, str(f))
 179      c.cmd("forceenabled 1")
 180      c.cmd("forcephase 3.141592653589793")  # π
 181      f = c.fields("dither 1 1")             # sin(π)=0, cos(π)=-1 → Kd -5%
 182      check("forcephase 控制载波", abs(f["Kd"] - 0.95) < 1e-6, str(f))
 183      c.cmd("forcephase 0")
 184      c.cmd("forcegrad 2.0 3.0")
 185      s = c.fields("status")
 186      check("forcegrad 写入积分器", abs(s["gradKp"] - 2.0) < 1e-6 and abs(s["gradKd"] - 3.0) < 1e-6, str(s))
 187      c.cmd("reset")
 188  
 189      # ========== 组 8：tick 主流程 ==========
 190      print("[组8] tick 主流程编排")
 191      f = c.fields("tick 10 9 1 20 0.02 1.0 2.0")   # 20kn > 15kn
 192      s = c.fields("status")
 193      check("高速去激活 enabled=0", s["enabled"] == 0, str(s))
 194      f = c.fields("tick 10 9 1 12 0.02 9.9 9.9")   # 无基线 → 跟随调度
 195      check("无基线跟随调度值", abs(f["Kp"] - 9.9) < 1e-9 and abs(f["Kd"] - 9.9) < 1e-9, str(f))
 196      for _ in range(5):                            # 带辨识快照 → 建基线
 197          c.fields("tick 10 9.5 1 12 0.02 9.9 9.9 1 1 0.2 8")
 198      s = c.fields("status")
 199      check("tick 辨识评估建基线", s["established"] == 1 and abs(s["curKp"] - 1.6) < 1e-6, str(s))
 200      f = c.fields("tick 10 9.5 1 12 0.02 9.9 9.9 1 1 0.2 8")
 201      check("基线建立后不跟随调度", abs(f["Kp"] - 9.9) > 0.1, str(f))
 202  
 203      # ========== 组 9：协议与健壮性 ==========
 204      print("[组9] 输出协议")
 205      r = c.cmd("nosuchcmd")
 206      check("未知命令报 ERR", r.startswith("ERR"), r)
 207      r = c.cmd("pole 0.2")
 208      check("参数不足报 ERR 用法", r.startswith("ERR"), r)
 209      r = c.cmd("accum")
 210      check("accum 缺参报 ERR", r.startswith("ERR"), r)
 211  
 212      c.close()
 213      print(f"\n==== 验收结果: {PASS} PASS / {FAIL} FAIL ====")
 214      sys.exit(1 if FAIL else 0)

 107  int main() {
 108      AutoTuner tuner;
 109      TunerDebugApi api(tuner);
 110      std::string line;
 111      // 仅交互终端打印横幅与提示符——脚本/管道模式保持输出纯净（key=value 可解析）
 112      const bool interactive = AR_ISATTY(AR_STDIN_FILENO) != 0;
 113      if (interactive) std::printf("ar_tuner_debug ready. 'help' 查看命令表。\n");
 114  
 115      while ((interactive ? (std::printf("> ") > 0) : true) && std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
 116          std::istringstream ss(line);
 117          std::string cmd;
 118          if (!(ss >> cmd)) continue;
 119  
 120          if (cmd == "quit" || cmd == "exit") break;
 121          if (cmd == "help") { printHelp(); continue; }
 122  
 123          // ---- 观测 ----
 124          if (cmd == "status") { printSnapshot(api.snapshot()); continue; }
 125          if (cmd == "j")      { std::printf("OK J=%.6f\n", api.currentJ()); continue; }
 126          if (cmd == "osc")    { std::printf("OK osc=%.4f\n", api.oscAmplitude()); continue; }
 127          if (cmd == "params") { printParams(api.params()); continue; }
 128          if (cmd == "setparam") {
 129              std::string name;
 130              double val;
 131              if (!(ss >> name >> val)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: setparam <名称> <值>\n"); continue; }
 132              AutoTuner::Params p = api.params();
 133              bool ok = true;
 134              if      (name == "zeta")          p.zeta = val;
 135              else if (name == "wn")            p.wn = val;
 136              else if (name == "escAmp")        p.escAmp = val;
 137              else if (name == "escFreq")       p.escFreq = val;
 138              else if (name == "escStep")       p.escStep = val;
 139              else if (name == "hpfTau")        p.escHPFtau = val;
 140              else if (name == "lpfTau")        p.escLPFtau = val;
 141              else if (name == "wU")            p.wU = val;
 142              else if (name == "wDu")           p.wDu = val;
 143              else if (name == "maxUpdateFrac") p.maxUpdateFrac = val;
 144              else if (name == "absMinUpdate")  p.absMinUpdate = val;
 145              else if (name == "zetaMin")       p.zetaMin = val;
 146              else if (name == "wnMax")         p.wnMax = val;
 147              else if (name == "oscMax")        p.oscMax = val;
 148              else if (name == "highSpeedKn")   p.highSpeedDeactivateKn = val;
 149              else if (name == "windowSec")     p.windowSec = val;
 150              else if (name == "dt")            p.dt = val;
 151              else ok = false;
 152              if (!ok) { std::printf("ERR 未知参数名 '%s'，'help' 查看可选名称\n", name.c_str()); continue; }
 153              api.setParams(p);
 154              std::printf("OK 注意：setParams 已复位调参器状态（基线已清空）\n");
 155              continue;
 156          }
 157  
 158          // ---- 层2 单功能 ----
 159          if (cmd == "pole") {
 160              double v[4] = {0, 0, 0.85, 0.20};
 161              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: pole <K> <T> [zeta wn]\n"); continue; }
 162              ss >> v[2] >> v[3];  // 可选参数（读不到保持默认）
 163              double Kp, Kd;
 164              if (api.polePlacement(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], Kp, Kd))
 165                  std::printf("OK Kp=%.6f Kd=%.6f\n", Kp, Kd);
 166              else
 167                  std::printf("ERR 极点配置失败（K/T 退化或非有限）\n");
 168              continue;
 169          }
 170          if (cmd == "check") {
 171              double v[5];
 172              if (!readN(ss, v, 5)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: check <K> <T> <Kp> <Kd> <osc>\n"); continue; }
 173              std::printf("OK pass=%d\n", api.stabilityCheck(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3], v[4]) ? 1 : 0);
 174              continue;
 175          }
 176          if (cmd == "baseline") {
 177              double v[2];
 178              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: baseline <K> <T>\n"); continue; }
 179              std::printf("OK established=%d\n", api.establishBaseline(v[0], v[1]) ? 1 : 0);
 180              continue;
 181          }
 182          if (cmd == "eval") {
 183              double v[5];
 184              if (!readN(ss, v, 5)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: eval <K> <T> <osc> <driftGate> <forceRebase>\n"); continue; }
 185              std::printf("OK accepted=%d\n",
 186                          api.evaluateEstimate(v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3] != 0.0, v[4] != 0.0) ? 1 : 0);
 187              continue;
 188          }
 189  
 190          // ---- ESC 各环节 ----
 191          if (cmd == "dither") {
 192              double v[2];
 193              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: dither <Kp> <Kd>\n"); continue; }
 194              double Kp = v[0], Kd = v[1];
 195              api.ditherOnce(Kp, Kd);
 196              std::printf("OK Kp=%.6f Kd=%.6f\n", Kp, Kd);
 197              continue;
 198          }
 199          if (cmd == "accum") {
 200              double v[3] = {0, 0, 1};
 201              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: accum <e_deg> <delta_deg> [oscOk]\n"); continue; }
 202              ss >> v[2];
 203              api.accumulateOnce(v[0], v[1], v[2] != 0.0);
 204              std::printf("OK\n");
 205              continue;
 206          }
 207          if (cmd == "step") {
 208              double v[2];
 209              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: step <Kp> <Kd>\n"); continue; }
 210              double Kp = v[0], Kd = v[1];
 211              api.escStepOnce(Kp, Kd);
 212              std::printf("OK Kp=%.6f Kd=%.6f\n", Kp, Kd);
 213              continue;
 214          }
 215          if (cmd == "settle") {
 216              double v[3] = {1, K_SHIP_DEFAULT, T_SHIP_DEFAULT};
 217              readN(ss, v, 3);  // 全可选：缺省 valid=1 + 典型船估计
 218              api.settleWindowOnce(v[0] != 0.0, v[1], v[2]);
 219              const auto s = api.snapshot();
 220              std::printf("OK curKp=%.6f curKd=%.6f\n", s.curKp, s.curKd);
 221              continue;
 222          }
 223          if (cmd == "clamp") {
 224              double v[2];
 225              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: clamp <new> <old>\n"); continue; }
 226              std::printf("OK value=%.6f\n", api.clampUpdate(v[0], v[1]));
 227              continue;
 228          }
 229  
 230          // ---- 振荡检测 ----
 231          if (cmd == "oscfeed") {
 232              double v[1];
 233              if (!readN(ss, v, 1)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: oscfeed <e_deg>\n"); continue; }
 234              api.oscFeed(v[0]);
 235              std::printf("OK osc=%.4f\n", api.oscAmplitude());
 236              continue;
 237          }
 238          if (cmd == "oscreset") { api.oscReset(); std::printf("OK\n"); continue; }
 239  
 240          // ---- 回退/重锚/生命周期 ----
 241          if (cmd == "revert") {
 242              double Kp = 0, Kd = 0;
 243              api.revertToBaseline(Kp, Kd);
 244              std::printf("OK Kp=%.6f Kd=%.6f\n", Kp, Kd);
 245              continue;
 246          }
 247          if (cmd == "rebase")  { api.rebaseEsc(); std::printf("OK\n"); continue; }
 248          if (cmd == "suspend") { api.suspend();   std::printf("OK\n"); continue; }
 249          if (cmd == "reset")   { api.reset();     std::printf("OK\n"); continue; }
 250  
 251          // ---- 主流程 ----
 252          if (cmd == "tick") {
 253              double v[11] = {};
 254              if (!readN(ss, v, 7)) {
 255                  std::printf("ERR 用法: tick <ref> <heading> <rudder> <speedKn> <dt> <sKp> <sKd> [exc valid K T]\n");
 256                  continue;
 257              }
 258              readN(ss, v + 7, 4);  // 可选辨识快照（缺省 excited=0 valid=0）
 259              TunerInput in;
 260              in.headingRefDeg = v[0]; in.headingDeg = v[1]; in.rudderDeg = v[2];
 261              in.speedKn = v[3]; in.dt = v[4]; in.schedKp = v[5]; in.schedKd = v[6];
 262              in.id.excited = (v[7] != 0.0); in.id.valid = (v[8] != 0.0);
 263              in.id.K = v[9]; in.id.T = v[10];
 264              const GainCommand g = api.tick(in);
 265              std::printf("OK Kp=%.6f Kd=%.6f\n", g.Kp, g.Kd);
 266              continue;
 267          }
 268  
 269          // ---- 强制注入（旁路稳定门，仅调试） ----
 270          if (cmd == "forcegains") {
 271              double v[2];
 272              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: forcegains <Kp> <Kd>\n"); continue; }
 273              api.forceGains(v[0], v[1]);
 274              std::printf("OK 警告：已旁路稳定门直接写增益\n");
 275              continue;
 276          }
 277          if (cmd == "forcebase") {
 278              double v[2];
 279              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: forcebase <Kp> <Kd>\n"); continue; }
 280              api.forceBaseline(v[0], v[1]);
 281              std::printf("OK 警告：已旁路极点配置与稳定门直接写基线\n");
 282              continue;
 283          }
 284          if (cmd == "forcephase") {
 285              double v[1];
 286              if (!readN(ss, v, 1)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: forcephase <rad>\n"); continue; }
 287              api.forceEscPhase(v[0]);
 288              std::printf("OK\n");
 289              continue;
 290          }
 291          if (cmd == "forcegrad") {
 292              double v[2];
 293              if (!readN(ss, v, 2)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: forcegrad <gKp> <gKd>\n"); continue; }
 294              api.forceGradient(v[0], v[1]);
 295              std::printf("OK\n");
 296              continue;
 297          }
 298          if (cmd == "forceenabled") {
 299              double v[1];
 300              if (!readN(ss, v, 1)) { std::printf("ERR 用法: forceenabled <0|1>\n"); continue; }
 301              api.forceEnabled(v[0] != 0.0);
 302              std::printf("OK\n");
 303              continue;
 304          }
 305  
 306          std::printf("ERR 未知命令 '%s'，'help' 查看命令表\n", cmd.c_str());
 307      }
 308      return 0;
 309  }

 210      def run(self):
 211          threads = [threading.Thread(target=self.poll_loop, daemon=True),
 212                     threading.Thread(target=self.console_loop, daemon=True)]
 213          if self.args.demo:
 214              threads.append(threading.Thread(target=self.demo_loop, daemon=True))
 215          for th in threads:
 216              th.start()
 217  
 218          fig, axes = self.build_fig()
 219          headless = self.args.duration is not None or matplotlib.get_backend() == "Agg"
 220          if headless:  # 固定时长：结束后一次性绘制保存
 221              time.sleep(self.args.duration or 10)
 222              self.stop.set()
 223              time.sleep(0.2)
 224              self.draw(axes)
 225              fig.tight_layout()
 226              out = self.args.out or "monitor.png"
 227              fig.savefig(out, dpi=150)
 228              print(f"已保存 {out}")
 229          else:         # 交互：FuncAnimation 实时刷新
 230              from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation
 231  
 232              def update(_):
 233                  self.draw(axes)
 234  
 235              # 必须持有引用——否则动画对象被 GC，窗口空白（matplotlib 官方陷阱）
 236              self._anim = FuncAnimation(fig, update, interval=int(self.args.interval * 1000),
 237                                         cache_frame_data=False)

 347  function sendParamsToEcu(scope){
 348    if (!State.ws || State.ws.readyState !== 1){
 349      log('参数下发失败：ECU 未连接', 'warn');
 350      return false;
 351    }
 352    const msg = { type: 'set_params', scope: scope, ts: Math.floor(Date.now()/1000) };
 353    switch (scope){
 354      case 'pd':
 355        msg.pd = Object.assign({}, State.pd);
 356        break;
 357      case 'sched':
 358        msg.sched = State.sched.map(p => Object.assign({}, p));
 359        break;
 360      case 'id':
 361        msg.id = { lambda:State.id.lambda, dt:State.id.dt,
 362                   deltaMin:State.id.deltaMin, rMin:State.id.rMin, p0:State.id.p0 };
 363        break;
 364      case 'tuner':
 365        msg.tuner = { zeta:State.at.zeta, wn:State.at.wn, escAmp:State.at.escAmp,
 366          escFreq:State.at.escFreq, escStep:State.at.escStep, wU:State.at.wU, wDu:State.at.wDu,
 367          maxUpd:State.at.maxUpd, zetaMin:State.at.zetaMin, wnMax:State.at.wnMax,
 368          oscMax:State.at.oscMax, hsDeact:State.at.hsDeact, window:State.at.window };
 369        break;
 370      case 'store':
 371        msg.store = Object.assign({}, State.ps);
 372        break;
 373      case 'mode':
 374        msg.mode = State.mode; msg.headingRef = State.headingRef;
 375        break;
 376      default:
 377        log('未知下发范围: ' + scope, 'err'); return false;
 378    }
 379    State.ws.send(JSON.stringify(msg));
 380    log(`参数已下发 [${scope}] → ECU`, 'ok');
 381    return true;
 382  }

 420  function pdUpdate(headingRef, headingAct, p, st){
 421    const e = diffDeg(headingRef, headingAct);
 422    if (Math.abs(e) < p.deadzone){
 423      st.prevErr = e; st.prevOut = 0; return 0;
 424    }
 425    let derivRaw = st.first ? 0 : (e - st.prevErr)/p.dt;
 426    if (st.first) st.first = false;
 427    const alpha = 1.0/(1.0 + p.tau/p.dt);
 428    const deriv = alpha*derivRaw + (1-alpha)*st.prevDeriv;
 429    let out = p.Kp*e + p.Kd*deriv;
 430    if (out >  p.dMax) out =  p.dMax;
 431    if (out < -p.dMax) out = -p.dMax;
 432    const maxDelta = p.ddMax * p.dt;
 433    const d = out - st.prevOut;
 434    if (d >  maxDelta) out = st.prevOut + maxDelta;
 435    if (d < -maxDelta) out = st.prevOut - maxDelta;
 436    out = Math.round(out/p.quant)*p.quant;
 437    st.prevErr = e; st.prevDeriv = deriv; st.prevOut = out;
 438    return out;
 439  }

 442  function schedQuery(speed, sea, table){
 443    sea = clamp(sea, 0, 3);
 444    for (const pt of table){
 445      if (pt.seaState !== sea) continue;
 446      if (speed >= pt.speedMin && speed < pt.speedMax) return {Kp:pt.Kp, Kd:pt.Kd};
 447    }
 448    // 取同海况末段
 449    let last = null;
 450    for (const pt of table){ if (pt.seaState===sea) last = pt; }
 451    return last ? {Kp:last.Kp, Kd:last.Kd} : {Kp:1.0, Kd:0.5};
 452  }

 455  function idUpdate(delta, r, p, st){
 456    st.excited = (Math.abs(delta) > p.deltaMin && Math.abs(r) > p.rMin);
 457    if (!st.excited){ st.prevR = r; st.first = false; return; }
 458    const dr = st.first ? 0 : (r - st.prevR)/p.dt;
 459    if (st.first) st.first = false;
 460    const phi = [delta, -dr];
 461    const Pphi = [st.P[0][0]*phi[0]+st.P[0][1]*phi[1],
 462                  st.P[1][0]*phi[0]+st.P[1][1]*phi[1]];
 463    const denom = p.lambda + phi[0]*Pphi[0] + phi[1]*Pphi[1];
 464    if (Math.abs(denom) < 1e-12){ st.prevR = r; return; }
 465    const K = [Pphi[0]/denom, Pphi[1]/denom];
 466    const y = r;
 467    const yhat = phi[0]*st.K + phi[1]*st.T;
 468    const err = y - yhat;
 469    st.K += K[0]*err;
 470    st.T += K[1]*err;
 471    const invL = 1.0/p.lambda;
 472    for (let i=0;i<2;i++) for (let j=0;j<2;j++)
 473      st.P[i][j] = invL*(st.P[i][j] - K[i]*Pphi[j]);
 474    st.prevR = r;
 475  }

 486  function stabilityCheck(K, T, Kp, Kd, osc, p){
 487    if (Math.abs(K)<1e-6 || Math.abs(T)<1e-6) return false;
 488    const wn = Math.sqrt(Kp*K/T);
 489    const zeta = (1 + Kd*K)/(2*Math.sqrt(T*Kp*K));
 490    if (zeta < p.zetaMin) return false;
 491    if (wn > p.wnMax) return false;
 492    if (osc > p.oscMax) return false;
 493    return true;
 494  }

 497  function escStep(p, st){
 498    if (!st.enabled) return;
 499    const J = computeJ(p, st);
 500    const dJ = J - st.J;
 501    st.J = J;
 502    st.escPhase += p.escFreq * p.window;
 503    const sKp = Math.sin(st.escPhase);
 504    const sKd = Math.sin(st.escPhase + Math.PI/2);
 505    const gradKp = dJ * sKp;
 506    const gradKd = dJ * sKd;
 507    let newKp = State.pd.Kp - p.escStep * gradKp;

 522  function accumulateJ(e, delta, p, st){
 523    const dd = delta - st.prevDelta;
 524    st.winE.push(Math.abs(e));
 525    st.winD.push(Math.abs(delta));
 526    st.winDD.push(Math.abs(dd));
 527    st.prevDelta = delta;
 528    const maxN = Math.floor(p.window / p.dt);
 529    while (st.winE.length > maxN){ st.winE.shift(); st.winD.shift(); st.winDD.shift(); }
 530  }

 531  function computeJ(p, st){
 532    if (st.winE.length === 0) return 0;
 533    let J = 0, t = 0;
 534    for (let i=0;i<st.winE.length;i++, t+=p.dt){
 535      J += (t*st.winE[i] + p.wU*st.winD[i] + p.wDu*st.winDD[i]) * p.dt;
 536    }
 537    return J;
 538  }

 547  function mvUpdate(headingAct, rateAct, dt){
 548    const mv = State.mv;
 549    if (mv.done || mv.idx < 0 || mv.idx >= mv.legs.length) return {isHeading:false, heading:0, rudder:0};
 550    if (mv.first){ mv.lastHeading = headingAct; mv.first = false; }
 551    const dh = diffDeg(headingAct, mv.lastHeading);
 552    mv.cumHeading += dh;
 553    mv.lastHeading = headingAct;
 554    mv.legElapsed += dt;
 555    const cur = mv.legs[mv.idx];
 556    let advance = false;
 557    switch (cur.trigger){
 558      case 'HEADING_REACHED':
 559        if (Math.abs(mv.cumHeading) >= Math.abs(cur.threshold)) advance = true;
 560        break;
 561      case 'TIME':
 562        if (mv.legElapsed >= cur.threshold) advance = true;
 563        break;
 564      case 'RATE':
 565        if (Math.abs(rateAct) <= cur.threshold) advance = true;
 566        break;
 567    }
 568    const cmd = cur.mode === 'HEADING'
 569      ? {isHeading:true, heading:cur.target, rudder:0}
 570      : {isHeading:false, heading:0, rudder:cur.target};
 571    if (advance){
 572      mv.legElapsed = 0; mv.cumHeading = 0;
 573      mv.idx = cur.next;
 574      if (mv.idx < 0 || mv.idx >= mv.legs.length) mv.done = true;
 575    }
 576    return cmd;
 577  }

 609  function mvSearch(psi0, t0, dt, cycles){
 610    const legs = []; let hdg = psi0, idx = 0;
 611    for (let c=0;c<cycles;c++){
 612      const t = t0 + c*dt;
 613      legs.push({mode:'HEADING', target:hdg, trigger:'TIME', threshold:t, next:idx+1}); idx++;
 614      hdg = normDeg(hdg + 90);
 615      legs.push({mode:'HEADING', target:hdg, trigger:'HEADING_REACHED', threshold:90, next:(c<cycles-1)?(idx+1):-1}); idx++;
 616    }
 617    return legs;

 621  function simStep(dt){
 622    // 简化 Nomoto：T·dr + r = K·δ
 623    const dr = (State.sim.K * State.sim.delta - State.sim.r) / State.sim.T;
 624    State.sim.r += dr * dt;
 625    State.sim.psi = normDeg(State.sim.psi + State.sim.r * dt);
 626    // 舵角跟随（一阶滞后）
 627    State.sim.delta += (State.sim.deltaCmd - State.sim.delta) * (dt / 0.5);
 628    // 注入噪声
 629    State.sim.psi += (Math.random()-0.5) * 0.05;
 630    State.sim.r   += (Math.random()-0.5) * 0.02;
 631    State.sensor.headingDeg = State.sim.psi;
 632    State.sensor.rateDegS   = State.sim.r;
 633    State.sensor.rudderDeg   = State.sim.delta;
 634  }

 641  function controlStep(){
 642    const dt = State.pd.dt;
 643    const s = State.sensor;
 644  
 645    // 仿真器推进
 646    if (State.simRunning) simStep(dt);
 647  
 648    let rudderCmd = 0;
 649    switch (State.mode){
 650      case 'MANUAL':
 651        rudderCmd = s.rudderDeg;
 652        break;
 653      case 'AUTO_HEADING': {
 654        const g = schedQuery(s.speedKn, s.seaState, State.sched);
 655        // 自动优化
 656        if (s.speedKn <= State.at.hsDeact){
 657          State.at.enabled = true;
 658          idUpdate(s.rudderDeg, s.rateDegS, State.id, State.id);
 659          if (State.id.excited){
 660            const [Kp2, Kd2] = polePlacement(State.id.K, State.id.T, State.at.zeta, State.at.wn);
 661            if (stabilityCheck(State.id.K, State.id.T, Kp2, Kd2, 0, State.at)){
 662              State.at.baselineKp = Kp2; State.at.baselineKd = Kd2;
 663              g.Kp = Kp2; g.Kd = Kd2;
 664            }
 665          }
 666        } else { State.at.enabled = false; }
 667        const e = diffDeg(State.headingRef, s.headingDeg);
 668        accumulateJ(e, s.rudderDeg, State.at, State.at);
 669        State.pd.Kp = g.Kp; State.pd.Kd = g.Kd;
 670        rudderCmd = pdUpdate(State.headingRef, s.headingDeg, State.pd, State.pdState);
 671        // ESC 周期触发
 672        escAccum += dt;
 673        if (escAccum >= State.at.window){
 674          escStep(State.at, State.at);
 675          escAccum = 0;
 676        }
 677        break;
 678      }
 679      case 'AUTO_MANEUVER': {
 680        const cmd = mvUpdate(s.headingDeg, s.rateDegS, dt);
 681        if (State.mv.done){ State.mode = 'AUTO_HEADING'; $('modeSel').value='AUTO_HEADING'; break; }
 682        if (cmd.isHeading){
 683          State.headingRef = cmd.heading;
 684          rudderCmd = pdUpdate(cmd.heading, s.headingDeg, State.pd, State.pdState);
 685        } else {
 686          rudderCmd = cmd.rudder;
 687        }
 688        break;
 689      }
 690      case 'HOLD':
 691        rudderCmd = 0;
 692        break;
 693    }
 694  
 695    // 输出到仿真器（或通过 WS 发给 ECU）
 696    State.sim.deltaCmd = rudderCmd;
 697    if (State.ws && State.ws.readyState === 1){
 698      State.ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'cmd', rudder:rudderCmd, mode:State.mode, headingRef:State.headingRef}));
 699    }
 700  
 701    // 记录历史
 702    const h = State.hist;
 703    h.heading.push(s.headingDeg); h.headingRef.push(State.headingRef);
 704    h.rudder.push(s.rudderDeg); h.rudderCmd.push(rudderCmd);
 705    h.error.push(diffDeg(State.headingRef, s.headingDeg)); h.rate.push(s.rateDegS);
 706    if (h.heading.length > h.maxLen){
 707      h.heading.shift(); h.headingRef.shift(); h.rudder.shift();
 708      h.rudderCmd.shift(); h.error.shift(); h.rate.shift();
 709    }
 710  
 711    // 更新 UI
 712    updateStatusUI();
 713    drawPlots();
 714  }

 753  function drawSeries(ctx, canvas, series, opts){
 754    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
 755    const W = rect.width, H = rect.height;
 756    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
 757    // 网格
 758    ctx.strokeStyle = '#313244'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
 759    for (let i=0;i<=4;i++){
 760      const y = H*i/4;
 761      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y); ctx.lineTo(W,y); ctx.stroke();
 762    }
 763    if (!series.length) return;
 764    // 自动量程
 765    let lo = opts.lo, hi = opts.hi;
 766    if (lo === undefined || hi === undefined){
 767      let mn = Infinity, mx = -Infinity;
 768      for (const s of series) for (const v of s.data){
 769        if (v < mn) mn = v; if (v > mx) mx = v;
 770      }
 771      if (!isFinite(mn)){ mn = -1; mx = 1; }
 772      const pad = (mx-mn)*0.1 + 1;
 773      lo = mn - pad; hi = mx + pad;
 774    }
 775    // 零线
 776    if (0 >= lo && 0 <= hi){
 777      const y0 = H - (0-lo)/(hi-lo)*H;
 778      ctx.strokeStyle = '#45475a'; ctx.setLineDash([4,4]);
 779      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0,y0); ctx.lineTo(W,y0); ctx.stroke();
 780      ctx.setLineDash([]);
 781    }
 782    // 曲线
 783    for (const s of series){
 784      ctx.strokeStyle = s.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath();
 785      for (let i=0;i<s.data.length;i++){
 786        const x = i/(s.data.length-1)*W;
 787        const y = H - (s.data[i]-lo)/(hi-lo)*H;
 788        if (i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
 789      }
 790      ctx.stroke();
 791    }
 792    // 量程标签
 793    ctx.fillStyle = '#a6adc8'; ctx.font = '10px monospace';
 794    ctx.fillText(hi.toFixed(1), W-32, 12);
 795    ctx.fillText(lo.toFixed(1), W-32, H-4);
 796  }

 877  function renderSchedTable(){

 881    State.sched.forEach((p, i) => {
 882      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
 883      tr.innerHTML = `<td><input type="number" value="${p.speedMin}" data-i="${i}" data-k="speedMin"></td>
 884        <td><input type="number" value="${p.speedMax}" data-i="${i}" data-k="speedMax"></td>
 885        <td><input type="number" value="${p.seaState}" data-i="${i}" data-k="seaState"></td>
 886        <td><input type="number" value="${p.Kp}" data-i="${i}" data-k="Kp"></td>
 887        <td><input type="number" value="${p.Kd}" data-i="${i}" data-k="Kd"></td>
 888        <td><button class="danger" data-del="${i}" style="padding:2px 6px">✕</button></td>`;
 889      tb.appendChild(tr);
 890    });
 891    tb.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(inp => {
 892      inp.onchange = e => {
 893        const i = +e.target.dataset.i, k = e.target.dataset.k;
 894        State.sched[i][k] = parseFloat(e.target.value);
 895      };
 896    });
 897    tb.querySelectorAll('button[data-del]').forEach(b => {
 898      b.onclick = e => {
 899        const i = +e.target.dataset.del;

 901        renderSchedTable();
 902      };
 903    });
 904  }

1016      State.ws = new WebSocket($('wsUrl').value);

1020      };

1030            State.sensor = Object.assign(State.sensor, m.sensor);
1031          } else if (m.type === 'params_ack'){
1032            log(`ECU 确认参数 [${m.scope}] v${m.version||'?'}`, 'ok');
1033          } else if (m.type === 'status'){
1034            if (m.faults && m.faults.length) log('ECU 故障: ' + m.faults.join(','), 'err');
1035          }
1036        } catch(e){}
1037      };

  30  def acf(x, m):
  31      x = x - x.mean()
  32      r0 = np.dot(x, x) / len(x)
  33      return np.array([np.dot(x[:-k], x[k:]) / (len(x) - k) / r0 for k in range(1, m + 1)])

  68      out, err, dnorm = [], [], []
  69      d_hat = 0.0  # 慢变干扰（风流压差等效）估计
  70      gamma, sigma = 0.02, 0.002
  71      for ti in t:
  72          psi_d = 30.0 if ti >= 20 else 0.0
  73          # 海况突变：K/T 漂移 + 慢变干扰（风流）与波浪高频分量同时增强
  74          if ti >= 120:
  75              Ke, Te = K*1.8, T*1.5
  76              d_wave = 1.8 + 0.8*np.sin(0.05*ti) + 0.8*np.sin(0.9*ti)
  77          else:
  78              Ke, Te = K, T
  79              d_wave = 0.3 + 0.15*np.sin(0.9*ti)
  80          e = psi - psi_d
  81          delta = -(1.6*e + 12.0*r)
  82          if kind == 'nn':
  83              # 自适应律：仅在航向保持段（|e| 小）学习，含 sigma 泄漏保证有界
  84              if abs(e) < 8.0:
  85                  d_hat += dt * (gamma*e - sigma*d_hat)
  86              d_hat = np.clip(d_hat, -6, 6)
  87              delta -= d_hat / K  # 前馈补偿，按标称增益折算到舵角
  88          u = np.clip(delta, -35, 35)
  89          r_dot = (-r + Ke*u)/Te + d_wave/Te
  90          r += r_dot*dt
  91          psi += r*dt
  92          out.append(psi); err.append(e); dnorm.append(abs(d_hat))
  93      return np.array(out), np.array(err), np.array(dnorm)

  33  def sim_implicit(h):
  34      # Brogliato-Polyakov-Efimov 隐式离散化（标量闭式解）
  35      n = int(T_end / h)
  36      t = np.arange(n) * h
  37      s = np.zeros(n); z = np.zeros(n); u = np.zeros(n)
  38      s[0], z[0] = s0, z0
  39      for k in range(n - 1):
  40          A = s[k] + h * (d(t[k]) + z[k])
  41          if abs(A) <= h * h * k2:
  42              s_new = 0.0
  43          else:
  44              sg = 1.0 if A > 0 else -1.0
  45              rhs = abs(A) - h * h * k2          # y + h*k1*sqrt(y) = rhs
  46              sq = (-h * k1 + np.sqrt(h * h * k1 * k1 + 4.0 * rhs)) / 2.0
  47              s_new = sg * sq * sq
  48          z_new = z[k] - h * k2 * sign(s_new)
  49          u[k] = -k1 * np.sqrt(abs(s_new)) * sign(s_new) + z_new
  50          s[k + 1], z[k + 1] = s_new, z_new
  51      u[-1] = -k1 * np.sqrt(abs(s[-1])) * sign(s[-1]) + z[-1]
  52      return t, s, u

  80  def simulate(rrs):
  81      phi = np.zeros_like(t); phid = np.zeros_like(t)
  82      delta = np.zeros_like(t); d_prev = 0.0
  83      for i in range(1, len(t)):
  84          acc = w_exc[i] + Kdelta*d_prev - 2*zeta*wphi*phid[i-1] - wphi**2*phi[i-1]
  85          phid[i] = phid[i-1] + acc*dt
  86          phi[i] = phi[i-1] + phid[i]*dt
  87          if rrs:
  88              d_cmd = -(1.0*phi[i] + 1.6*phid[i])
  89          else:
  90              d_cmd = 0.0
  91          d_cmd = np.clip(d_cmd, np.deg2rad(-12), np.deg2rad(12))
  92          max_step = np.deg2rad(10)*dt   # 舵速限制 10°/s
  93          d_prev += np.clip(d_cmd - d_prev, -max_step, max_step)
  94          delta[i] = d_prev
  95      return np.rad2deg(phi), np.rad2deg(delta)

  23  def run(mode):
  24      y = ym = 0.0
  25      th1, th2 = 1.0, 0.4    # 初始猜测偏离真值
  26      out = []
  27      for tt in t:
  28          r = ref_input(tt)
  29          d = 0.35 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.08 * tt) + 0.15 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.17 * tt)  # 波浪扰动
  30          u = th1 * r - th2 * y
  31          u_sat = np.clip(u, -u_max, u_max)
  32          e = y - ym
  33          # 自适应律
  34          leak1 = leak2 = 0.0
  35          if mode == 'sigma':        # σ-modification
  36              leak1, leak2 = sigma * th1, sigma * th2
  37          elif mode == 'e':          # e-modification
  38              leak1, leak2 = sigma * abs(e) * th1, sigma * abs(e) * th2
  39          dth1 = -gamma * e * r - gamma * leak1
  40          dth2 = gamma * e * y - gamma * leak2
  41          th1 += dth1 * dt
  42          th2 += dth2 * dt
  43          ym += (-am * ym + bm * r) * dt
  44          y += (-a * y + b * u_sat + d) * dt
  45          out.append((y, ym, e, th1, th2))
  46      return np.array(out)

 101  def fuzzy_out(e, ec):
 102      num, den = 0.0, 0.0

 106  def simulate(mode):
 107      """运动学仿真：ẋ=Ucos(ψ+β), ẏ=Usin(ψ+β), 航向回路一阶惯性。"""
 108      x, y, psi = 0.0, 60.0, 0.0
 109      y_int, beta_hat = 0.0, 0.0
 110      gam = 1e-4     # AILOS 自适应增益（Fossen 2015 律中 γ 需取小值，量级 ~1/(U·Δ)）
 111      k_i = 1.0      # ILOS 积分增益系数
 112      ys, psi_hist, bhat_hist = [], [], []
 113      for _ in range(N):
 114          y_e = y
 115          if mode == 'PLOS':
 116              psi_d = np.arctan(-y_e / Delta)
 117          elif mode == 'ILOS':
 118              den = Delta**2 + (y_e + y_int)**2
 119              psi_d = np.arctan(-(y_e + y_int) / Delta)
 120              y_int += dt * k_i * Delta * U * y_e / den
 121          else:  # AILOS (Fossen et al. 2015)
 122              den = np.sqrt(Delta**2 + (y_e + Delta * beta_hat)**2)
 123              psi_d = np.arctan(-y_e / Delta - beta_hat)
 124              beta_hat += dt * gam * U * Delta * y_e / den
 125          psi += dt * (psi_d - psi) / tau
 126          x += dt * U * np.cos(psi + beta_true)
 127          y += dt * U * np.sin(psi + beta_true)
 128          ys.append(y_e)
 129          psi_hist.append(psi)
 130          bhat_hist.append(np.degrees(beta_hat))
 131      return np.array(ys), np.array(bhat_hist)

 142  def fig4():
 143      rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
 144      dt, win_sec = 0.02, 60.0
 145      a, w, step = 0.05, 0.5, 0.02   # 演示用载波频率高于工程值(0.05 rad/s)，便于单窗内含多个周期
 146      tau_hpf, tau_lpf = 5.0, 10.0
 147      win_beats = int(win_sec / dt)
 148  
 149      def cost(kp):  # 未知最优在 kp*=1.3；尺度放大便于演示
 150          return 500.0 * (kp - 1.3) ** 2 + 75.0
 151  
 152      kp = 2.0
 153      kp_hist, g_hist, j_hist = [kp], [], []
 154      phase = 0.0
 155      hpf_y, hpf_c_prev, demod_sum, grad = 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
 156      t_wave, kp_wave = [], []
 157      n_win = 12
 158      for wn_ in range(n_win):
 159          demod_sum, cnt = 0.0, 0
 160          for k in range(win_beats):
 161              t = (wn_ * win_beats + k) * dt
 162              kp_d = kp * (1 + a * np.sin(phase))
 163              c = cost(kp_d) * dt + rng.normal(0, 5e-3)  # 成本增量+测量噪声
 164              al_h = tau_hpf / (tau_hpf + dt)
 165              hpf_y = al_h * (hpf_y + c - hpf_c_prev)
 166              hpf_c_prev = c
 167              demod_sum += hpf_y * np.sin(phase)
 168              cnt += 1
 169              phase += w * dt
 170              t_wave.append(t); kp_wave.append(kp_d)
 171          g = 2.0 * demod_sum / (a * cnt)
 172          al_l = win_sec / (tau_lpf + win_sec)
 173          grad = (1 - al_l) * grad + al_l * g
 174          kp_new = kp - step * grad
 175          dmax = max(abs(kp) * 0.10, 1e-3)
 176          kp = kp + np.clip(kp_new - kp, -dmax, dmax)
 177          kp_hist.append(kp); g_hist.append(grad); j_hist.append(cost(kp))
 178  
 179      fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11, 7.5))
 180      ks = np.linspace(0.6, 2.4, 200)
 181      axs[0, 0].plot(ks, 500.0 * (ks - 1.3) ** 2 + 75.0, color=C_GRAY, lw=2, label="真实成本 J(Kp)（对调参器不可见）")
 182      axs[0, 0].plot(kp_hist[1:], j_hist, "o-", color=C_ORANGE, ms=6, lw=1.5, label="ESC 轨迹（每窗一点）")
 183      axs[0, 0].axvline(1.3, color=C_GREEN, ls="--", lw=1)
 184      axs[0, 0].text(1.33, 400, "未知最优 Kp*=1.3", color=C_GREEN, fontsize=9)
 185      axs[0, 0].set_xlabel("Kp"); axs[0, 0].set_ylabel("J"); axs[0, 0].legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
 186      axs[0, 0].set_title("① 无模型寻优：沿估测梯度爬向谷底")
 187  
 188      axs[0, 1].plot(np.arange(len(kp_hist)) * 60, kp_hist, "s-", color=C_BLUE, lw=1.8)
 189      axs[0, 1].axhline(1.3, color=C_GREEN, ls="--", lw=1)
 190      axs[0, 1].set_xlabel("时间 (s)"); axs[0, 1].set_ylabel("Kp 基线值")
 191      axs[0, 1].set_title("② 增益收敛（每 60 s 窗口更新一次，步长≤10%）")
 192  
 193      tw = np.array(t_wave[:3000]); kw = np.array(kp_wave[:3000])
 194      axs[1, 0].plot(tw, kw, color=C_ORANGE, lw=0.8)
 195      axs[1, 0].set_xlabel("时间 (s)"); axs[1, 0].set_ylabel("实际施加的 Kp")
 196      axs[1, 0].set_title("③ 窗口内增益载波 Kp·(1+a·sinωt)，a=5%")
 197  
 198      axs[1, 1].plot(np.arange(1, len(g_hist) + 1) * 60, g_hist, "o-", color=C_PURPLE, lw=1.8)
 199      axs[1, 1].axhline(0, color=C_GRAY, lw=0.8)
 200      axs[1, 1].set_xlabel("时间 (s)"); axs[1, 1].set_ylabel("梯度估计 ĝ")
 201      axs[1, 1].set_title("④ 解调+LPF 后的梯度估计：Kp>1.3 时 ĝ>0 → 减 Kp")
 202      for a_ in axs.flat: a_.grid(alpha=0.3)
 203      fig.suptitle("ESC 数值演示：从 Kp=2.0 自收敛到未知最优 1.3（复现 auto_tuner.hpp 的算法链）", fontsize=13)
 204      fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/fig4_esc_demo.png", bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

 208  def fig5():
 209      K_true, T_true = 0.8, 12.0
 210      dt = 0.02
 211      t_end = 900.0
 212      n = int(t_end / dt)
 213      dz, phiz = 20.0, 20.0
 214      rudder = np.zeros(n); heading = np.zeros(n); rate = np.zeros(n)
 215      # 生成 Z 形舵令：航向累计变化达 ±20° 反舵
 216      d, dsign, cum = dz, 1, 0.0   # 首段即打 +dz 满舵
 217      psi, r = 0.0, 0.0
 218      for k in range(n):
 219          rudder[k] = d
 220          r += dt * (K_true * d - r) / T_true
 221          psi += r * dt
 222          heading[k] = psi; rate[k] = r
 223          cum += r * dt
 224          if cum * (dsign * phiz) >= phiz * phiz:
 225              dsign *= -1; d = dsign * dz; cum = 0.0
 226  
 227      # 按工程实现做 RLS（1s 拍、激励门控、归一化）
 228      lam, beat = 0.98, 1.0
 229      d_scale, dr_scale = 50.0, 1.0
 230      theta = np.zeros(2); P = np.eye(2)
 231      prev_r, elapsed, first = 0.0, 0.0, True
 232      t_beat, k_hat, t_hat = [], [], []
 233      for k in range(n):
 234          elapsed += dt
 235          if elapsed < beat: continue
 236          bdt = elapsed; elapsed = 0.0
 237          dr = 0.0 if first else (rate[k] - prev_r) / bdt
 238          first = False
 239          excited = abs(rudder[k]) > 3.0 and (abs(rate[k]) > 0.5 or abs(dr) > 0.2)
 240          if excited:
 241              phi = np.array([rudder[k] / d_scale, -dr / dr_scale])
 242              denom = lam + phi @ P @ phi
 243              g = P @ phi / denom
 244              err = rate[k] - phi @ theta
 245              theta += g * err
 246              P = (P - np.outer(g, phi) @ P) / lam
 247              P[0, 0] = max(P[0, 0], 1e-3); P[1, 1] = max(P[1, 1], 1e-3)
 248              t_beat.append(k * dt); k_hat.append(theta[0] / d_scale); t_hat.append(theta[1] / dr_scale)
 249          prev_r = rate[k]
 250  
 251      t = np.arange(n) * dt
 252      fig, axs = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10.5, 8.5), sharex=False)
 253      axs[0].plot(t, rudder, color=C_ORANGE, lw=1.2, label="舵角 δ (±20°)")
 254      axs[0].set_ylabel("舵角 (°)"); axs[0].legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=9)
 255      axs[0].set_title("① P14 自动 Z 形辨识试验：ManeuverSequencer 生成 ±20°/±20° Z 形舵令")
 256      axs[1].plot(t, heading, color=C_BLUE, lw=1.2, label="航向 ψ 响应（Nomoto K=0.8, T=12s）")
 257      axs[1].set_ylabel("航向 (°)"); axs[1].legend(loc="upper right", fontsize=9)
 258      axs[1].set_title("② 船舶锯齿形航向响应——转向反向瞬态携带 T 的信息")
 259      axs[2].plot(t_beat, k_hat, color=C_GREEN, lw=1.8, label="K 估计（真值 0.8）")
 260      axs[2].plot(t_beat, np.array(t_hat) / 20.0, color=C_PURPLE, lw=1.8, label="T 估计/20（真值 12s）")
 261      axs[2].axhline(0.8, color=C_GREEN, ls="--", lw=0.8); axs[2].axhline(0.6, color=C_PURPLE, ls="--", lw=0.8)
 262      axs[2].set_xlabel("时间 (s)"); axs[2].set_ylabel("估计值"); axs[2].legend(fontsize=9)
 263      axs[2].set_title("③ RLS 在线收敛过程（λ=0.98 遗忘因子，逐步逼近真值 K=0.8 / T=12s）→ 收官 establishBaseline()")
 264      for a_ in axs: a_.grid(alpha=0.3)
 265      fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(f"{OUT}/fig5_zigzag_rls.png", bbox_inches="tight"); plt.close(fig)

  50  def load_tune_csv(name):
  51      """读取 --tune 导出的 CSV（样本行）。"""
  52      path = os.path.join(DATA, name)
  53      import csv
  54      rows = []
  55      with open(path, newline="") as f:
  56          for r in csv.DictReader(f):
  57              if r["settle"] == "1":
  58                  continue
  59              rows.append({k: float(r[k]) for k in
  60                           ["t", "psi", "psiRef", "rudderCmd", "rudderAct",
  61                            "rate", "error", "Kp", "Kd", "KpCenter", "KdCenter",
  62                            "Khat", "That", "Jwindow"]})
  63      return rows

  88  def fig_practical_stability():
  89      rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
  90      dt = 0.02
  91      T = 600.0
  92      t = np.arange(0, T, dt)
  93      omega = 0.3          # 载波 (rad/s)，为展示效果取较大
  94      a = 0.12             # 抖动幅值
  95      k_int = 0.6          # 积分增益
  96      th_star = 1.3
  97  
  98      # 经典 ESC 简化仿真：静态 map J=(θ-θ*)²，HPF 近似为去慢变均值，解调+LPF+积分
  99      th_hat = np.zeros_like(t); th_hat[0] = 2.2
 100      xi = 0.0; eta = 0.0
 101      wl, wh = 0.15, 0.08
 102      th_act = np.zeros_like(t); J = np.zeros_like(t); g_est = np.zeros_like(t)
 103      for i in range(1, len(t)):
 104          th_act[i] = th_hat[i-1] + a * np.sin(omega * t[i])
 105          J[i] = (th_act[i] - th_star) ** 2 + 0.02 * rng.standard_normal()
 106          eta += dt * (-wh * eta + wh * J[i])          # LPF 估直流
 107          hp = J[i] - eta                               # HPF 输出（去直流）
 108          xi += dt * (-wl * xi + wl * hp * np.sin(omega * t[i]))  # 解调 + LPF
 109          g_est[i] = xi
 110          th_hat[i] = th_hat[i-1] - k_int * xi * dt     # 最小化：负梯度方向
 111  
 112      fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(11.5, 6.4),
 113                              gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [2.2, 1.0]})
 114      ax = axs[0, 0]
 115      ax.plot(t, th_act, color=C_ORANGE, lw=0.8, label=r"实际参数 $\theta(t)=\hat\theta+a\sin\omega t$")
 116      ax.plot(t, th_hat, color=C_BLUE, lw=1.8, label=r"估计中心 $\hat\theta(t)$")
 117      ax.axhline(th_star, color=C_GREEN, ls="--", lw=1.2)
 118      ax.axhspan(th_star - a, th_star + a, color=C_GREEN, alpha=0.10)
 119      ax.text(300, th_star + a + 0.08, "实用稳定邻域 $O(a)$", color=C_GREEN, fontsize=10)
 120      ax.text(300, th_star - a - 0.16, r"未知最优 $\theta^*$（绿色虚线）", color=C_GREEN, fontsize=10)
 121      ax.set_xlabel("时间 t (s)"); ax.set_ylabel(r"参数 $\theta$")
 122      ax.set_title("① 全程：指数式接近最优点，然后停留在邻域内", fontsize=11)
 123      ax.legend(loc="lower right", fontsize=9); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
 124  
 125      ax = axs[0, 1]
 126      m = t > 480
 127      ax.plot(t[m], th_act[m], color=C_ORANGE, lw=1.2)
 128      ax.axhline(th_star, color=C_GREEN, ls="--", lw=1.2)
 129      ax.axhspan(th_star - a, th_star + a, color=C_GREEN, alpha=0.10)
 130      ax.set_title("② 放大：永远停不下来的小振荡", fontsize=11)
 131      ax.set_xlabel("t (s)"); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
 132  
 133      ax = axs[1, 0]
 134      ax.plot(t, J, color=C_GRAY, lw=0.5, alpha=0.7, label="含噪代价 J(t)")
 135      # 滑窗均值
 136      w = int(20 / dt)
 137      Jm = np.convolve(J, np.ones(w) / w, mode="same")
 138      ax.plot(t, Jm, color=C_RED, lw=1.6, label="J 的滑动平均（20 s 窗）")
 139      ax.set_xlabel("时间 t (s)"); ax.set_ylabel("代价 J")
 140      ax.set_title("③ 代价随之下降并稳定在小值（残余振荡是 ESC 的固有代价）", fontsize=11)
 141      ax.legend(fontsize=9); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
 142  
 143      ax = axs[1, 1]
 144      ax.plot(t, 2 * g_est / a, color=C_PURPLE, lw=1.0)
 145      ax.axhline(0, color=C_GRAY, lw=0.8)
 146      ax.set_title("④ 梯度估计 ĝ：收敛后绕 0 波动", fontsize=11)
 147      ax.set_xlabel("t (s)"); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
 148  
 149      fig.suptitle("ESC 的“实用稳定性”：不收敛到一个点，而是收敛到最优点的小邻域并持续微振",
 150                   fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")
 151      fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 1, 0.95))
 152      fig.savefig(os.path.join(OUT, "esc_practical_stability.png"), bbox_inches="tight")
 153      plt.close(fig)

 140  def search_path():
 141      model_k, model_t, zeta = .2, 8., .85
 142      wn = np.linspace(.10, .40, 301)
 143      kp = wn**2 * model_t / model_k
 144      kd = (2*zeta*wn*model_t - 1) / model_k
 145      assert np.isclose(.2**2 * model_t / model_k, 1.6)
 146      assert np.isclose((2*zeta*.2*model_t - 1)/model_k, 8.6)

 153                           textcoords="offset points", fontsize=10)

 143  def lane_boxes(y_center, boxes, color, lane_label):
 144      n = len(boxes)
 145      bw, bh = 1.72, 1.15
 146      x0 = 1.25
 147      gap = (13.2 - 0.1 - x0 - n * bw) / (n - 1)
 148      # 泳道标签
 149      ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.05, y_center - bh / 2 - 0.28), 1.05, bh + 0.56,
 150                                  boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", fc=color, ec="k"))
 151      ax.text(0.575, y_center, lane_label, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold",
 152              color="white", ha="center", va="center", linespacing=1.3)
 153      xs = []
 154      for i, txt in enumerate(boxes):
 155          x = x0 + i * (bw + gap)
 156          xs.append(x)
 157          ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x, y_center - bh / 2), bw, bh,
 158                                      boxstyle="round,pad=0.02", fc="white",
 159                                      ec=color, lw=1.8))
 160          ax.text(x + bw / 2, y_center, txt, fontsize=9.2, ha="center", va="center",
 161                  color="#1B2A4A", linespacing=1.25)
 162          if i > 0:
 163              ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((xs[i - 1] + bw + 0.02, y_center),
 164                                           (x - 0.02, y_center),
 165                                           arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=15,
 166                                           color=color, lw=1.6))

  32  def textbox(slide, x, y, w, h, lines, size=16, color=DARK, bold=False,
  33              align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, line_spacing=1.15, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
  34      """lines: list of (text, dict overrides) 或纯字符串"""
  35      tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
  36      tf = tb.text_frame
  37      tf.word_wrap = True
  38      tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
  39      for i, line in enumerate(lines):
  40          p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
  41          if isinstance(line, str):
  42              line = (line, {})
  43          text, ov = line
  44          p.alignment = ov.get("align", align)
  45          p.line_spacing = ov.get("line_spacing", line_spacing)
  46          p.space_after = Pt(ov.get("space_after", 6))
  47          run = p.add_run()
  48          run.text = text
  49          f = run.font
  50          f.name = ov.get("font", FONT)
  51          f.size = Pt(ov.get("size", size))
  52          f.bold = ov.get("bold", bold)
  53          f.color.rgb = ov.get("color", color)
  54      return tb

  67  def pic_fit(slide, path, x, y, max_w, max_h):
  68      """按比例放入图片，不超出 (max_w, max_h)，返回 shape"""
  69      from PIL import Image
  70      iw, ih = Image.open(path).size
  71      ratio = min(max_w / iw, max_h / ih)
  72      w, h = int(iw * ratio), int(ih * ratio)
  73      return slide.shapes.add_picture(path, x + int((max_w - w) / 2), y + int((max_h - h) / 2), w, h)

  90  def table(slide, x, y, w, h, data, col_widths=None, size=12, header_fill=BLUE):
  91      rows, cols = len(data), len(data[0])
  92      gt = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, x, y, w, h).table
  93      if col_widths:
  94          total = sum(col_widths)

  97      for r in range(rows):

 100              cell.text = str(data[r][c])
 101              cell.margin_left = Inches(0.06); cell.margin_right = Inches(0.06)
 102              cell.margin_top = Inches(0.03); cell.margin_bottom = Inches(0.03)
 103              cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
 104              for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
 105                  p.line_spacing = 1.05
 106                  for run in p.runs:
 107                      run.font.name = FONT
 108                      run.font.size = Pt(size if r else size + 0.5)
 109                      run.font.bold = (r == 0)
 110                      run.font.color.rgb = WHITE if r == 0 else DARK
 111              if r == 0:
 112                  cell.fill.solid(); cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_fill
 113              elif r % 2 == 0:
 114                  cell.fill.solid(); cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0xEE, 0xF3, 0xFA)

  43  def wrap_line(seg, size_pt, bold, max_w):
  44      """贪心换行：优先在空格处断行，CJK 逐字断行"""
  45      out, cur = [], ""
  46      for ch in seg:
  47          if text_w(cur + ch, size_pt, bold) <= max_w or not cur:
  48              cur += ch
  49          else:
  50              if ch == " ":
  51                  out.append(cur); cur = ""
  52                  continue
  53              sp = cur.rfind(" ")
  54              if sp > 0 and text_w(cur[:sp], size_pt, bold) > max_w * 0.4:
  55                  out.append(cur[:sp]); cur = cur[sp + 1:] + ch
  56              else:
  57                  out.append(cur); cur = ch
  58      out.append(cur)
  59      return out

  75  def render_textframe(ax, tf, x, y, w, h):
  76      """x,y 为左上角（英寸，pptx 坐标系）"""
  77      anchor = tf.vertical_anchor
  78      blocks = []
  79      for para in tf.paragraphs:
  80          text = "".join(r.text for r in para.runs)
  81          if not text.strip():
  82              continue
  83          size, bold, color = para_style(para)
  84          ls = para.line_spacing if para.line_spacing else 1.15
  85          sa = (para.space_after.pt if para.space_after else 6) / 72.0
  86          lines = []
  87          for seg in text.split("\n"):
  88              lines.extend(wrap_line(seg, size, bold, w - 0.1))
  89          lh = size * 1.22 * ls / 72.0
  90          blocks.append((lines, size, bold, color, lh, sa,
  91                         para.alignment or PP_ALIGN.LEFT))
  92      total_h = sum(len(b[0]) * b[4] + b[5] for b in blocks)
  93      if anchor == MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE:
  94          cy = y + max(0.0, (h - total_h) / 2)
  95      else:
  96          cy = y + 0.05
  97      for lines, size, bold, color, lh, sa, align in blocks:
  98          for ln in lines:
  99              lw = text_w(ln, size, bold)
 100              if align == PP_ALIGN.CENTER:
 101                  lx = x + (w - lw) / 2
 102              elif align == PP_ALIGN.RIGHT:
 103                  lx = x + w - lw - 0.05
 104              else:
 105                  lx = x + 0.05
 106              ax.text(lx, cy + lh * 0.78, ln, fontsize=size,
 107                      fontweight="bold" if bold else "normal",
 108                      color=color, ha="left", va="baseline")
 109              cy += lh
 110          cy += sa

 141  def render_slide(fig, slide, sw_in, sh_in):
 142      ax = fig.add_axes([0, 0, 1, 1])

 150          if sh.shape_type == MSO_SHAPE_TYPE.PICTURE:
 151              import io
 152              img = mpimg.imread(io.BytesIO(sh.image.blob), format="png")
 153              ax.imshow(img, extent=[x, x + w, y + h, y], zorder=3,
 154                        interpolation="lanczos")
 155          elif sh.has_table:
 156              render_table(ax, sh, x, y)

 186  def github_slug(text: str) -> str:
 187      """生成 GitHub 风格锚点 id：转小写、去标点、空格转横线（保留中文）。"""
 188      children = MarkdownIt("commonmark").parseInline(text)[0].children or []
 189      text = "".join(t.content for t in children if t.type in ("text", "code_inline", "image"))
 190      text = text.lower()
 191      text = re.sub(r"[^\w\u4e00-\u9fff\s-]", "", text, flags=re.UNICODE)
 192      return re.sub(r"\s", "-", text)

 195  def build_md_parser() -> MarkdownIt:
 196      md = MarkdownIt("gfm-like", {"html": True})
 197  
 198      # 给标题添加 GitHub 风格锚点 id
 199      def heading_open(tokens, idx, options, env):
 200          token = tokens[idx]
 201          inline = tokens[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < len(tokens) and tokens[idx + 1].type == "inline" else None
 202          text = inline.content if inline else ""
 203          for placeholder, original in env.get("math_placeholders", {}).items():
 204              text = text.replace(placeholder, original)
 205          base = github_slug(text)
 206          used = env.setdefault("heading_ids", set())
 207          slug, count = base, 0
 208          while slug in used:
 209              count += 1
 210              slug = f"{base}-{count}"
 211          used.add(slug)
 212          return f'<{token.tag} id="{slug}">'
 213  
 214      md.renderer.rules["heading_open"] = heading_open
 215      return md
