 218  def protect_math(md_text: str):
 219      r"""把 $...$/$$...$$ 数学块替换为占位符，避免 markdown-it 转义数学反斜杠。
 220  
 221      markdown-it 会把 `\\`、`\,`、`\;` 等按 CommonMark 转义处理（如 `\\`→`\`、
 222      `\,`→`,`），导致 KaTeX 公式被破坏。这里先按原样取出数学内容、用占位符渲染
 223      Markdown，渲染后再还原，保证 KaTeX 收到未经转义的原始公式。
 224      """
 225      lines = md_text.splitlines(keepends=True)
 226      masked_code, placeholders = {}, {}
 227      prefix = "@@DOCMATH"
 228      while prefix in md_text:
 229          prefix += "X"
 230  
 231      def save_code(value):
 232          token = f"{prefix}CODE{len(masked_code)}@@"
 233          masked_code[token] = value
 234          return token
 235  
 236      # Parser maps handle tilde fences, longer fences and nested code blocks.
 237      for token in reversed(MarkdownIt("commonmark").parse(md_text)):
 238          if token.type in ("fence", "code_block") and token.map:
 239              start, end = token.map
 240              lines[start:end] = [save_code("".join(lines[start:end]))]
 241      masked = "".join(lines)
 242      masked = re.sub(r"(`+)([\s\S]*?)\1(?!`)", lambda m: save_code(m[0]), masked)
 243  
 244      def save_math(match):
 245          token = f"{prefix}{len(placeholders)}@@"
 246          placeholders[token] = match[0]
 247          return token
 248  
 249      pattern = (r"(?<!\\)\$\$[\s\S]+?(?<!\\)\$\$"
 250                 r"|(?<![\\$])\$(?![$\s])(?:\\.|[^$\\\n])+?(?<![\\\s])\$(?!\$)"
 251                 r"|(?<!\\)\\\([\s\S]+?\\\)"
 252                 r"|(?<!\\)\\\[[\s\S]+?\\\]")
 253      masked = re.sub(pattern, save_math, masked)
 254      for token, original in masked_code.items():
 255          masked = masked.replace(token, original)
 256      return masked, placeholders

 259  def restore_math(html_body: str, placeholders: dict) -> str:
 260      """Restore TeX as HTML text, never as markup (notably <, > and &)."""

 263      return html_body

 266  def fix_relative_links(html_body: str, md_dir: str) -> str:
 267      """将相对路径图片转换为 file:// 绝对路径，保留中文和 URL 编码。"""
 268      def repl_img(m):
 269          attrs = m.group(1)
 270          def repl_src(sm):
 271              url = html_mod.unescape(sm.group(1))
 272              parsed = urlsplit(url)
 273              if parsed.scheme or url.startswith("//"):
 274                  return sm.group(0)
 275              uri = (Path(md_dir) / unquote(parsed.path)).resolve().as_uri()
 276              if parsed.fragment:
 277                  uri += "#" + parsed.fragment
 278              return f'src="{html_mod.escape(uri, quote=True)}"'
 279          attrs = re.sub(r'src="([^"]*)"', repl_src, attrs)
 280          return "<img " + attrs + ">"
 281  
 282      html_body = re.sub(r"<img\s+([^>]*?)/?>", repl_img, html_body)
 283      return html_body

 300  <html lang="zh-CN" data-render-status="pending">
 301  <head>
 302  <meta charset="utf-8">
 303  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
 304  <title>{html_mod.escape(title)}</title>
 305  <link rel="stylesheet" href="{KATEX_CSS}">
 306  <style>{CSS}</style>
 307  </head>
 308  <body>

 311  <script src="{KATEX_AUTORENDER}"></script>
 312  <script src="{MERMAID_JS}"></script>
 313  <script>
 314  async function renderAll() {{
 315      try {{
 316          // 数学公式包括表格单元格；代码块中的美元符号不作为公式。
 317          if ({str(bool(math_placeholders)).lower()} && !window.renderMathInElement) {{
 318              throw new Error('KaTeX resources unavailable');
 319          }}
 320          if (window.renderMathInElement) {{
 321              renderMathInElement(document.body, {{
 322                  delimiters: [
 323                      {{ left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true }},
 324                      {{ left: '$', right: '$', display: false }},
 325                      {{ left: '\\\\(', right: '\\\\)', display: false }},
 326                      {{ left: '\\\\[', right: '\\\\]', display: true }}
 327                  ],
 328                  throwOnError: false,
 329                  strict: 'ignore'
 330              }});
 331          }}
 332          // 渲染 mermaid 图
 333          const diagrams = document.querySelectorAll('pre code.language-mermaid');
 334          if (diagrams.length && !window.mermaid) throw new Error('Mermaid resources unavailable');
 335          if (diagrams.length) {{
 336              document.querySelectorAll('pre code.language-mermaid').forEach(function (el) {{
 337                  var pre = el.closest('pre');
 338                  if (pre) pre.classList.add('mermaid-block');
 339              }});
 340              mermaid.initialize({{
 341                  startOnLoad: false,
 342                  theme: 'default',
 343                  securityLevel: 'loose',
 344                  fontFamily: {FONT_FAMILY!r}
 345              }});
 346              await mermaid.run({{ querySelector: 'pre code.language-mermaid' }});
 347          }}
 348          await document.fonts.ready;
 349          await Promise.all(Array.from(document.images, img => img.complete ? Promise.resolve() :
 350              new Promise(resolve => {{ img.onload = resolve; img.onerror = resolve; }})));
 351          if (document.querySelector('.katex-error') ||
 352              Array.from(document.images).some(img => !img.naturalWidth)) {{
 353              throw new Error('Invalid formula or missing image');
 354          }}
 355          // Shrink only oversized display equations, preserving complete expressions.
 356          document.querySelectorAll('.katex-display').forEach(el => {{
 357              const equation = el.querySelector('.katex');
 358              if (equation && equation.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth) {{
 359                  equation.style.fontSize = (100 * el.clientWidth / equation.scrollWidth) + '%';
 360              }}
 361          }});
 362          document.documentElement.dataset.renderStatus = 'ready';
 363      }} catch (e) {{
 364          document.documentElement.dataset.renderStatus = 'error';
 365          document.documentElement.dataset.renderError = String(e);
 366          console.error('render error:', e);
 367      }}
 368  }}
 369  renderAll();
 370  </script>
 371  </body>
 372  </html>"""
 373      return html

 376  def html_to_pdf(html_content: str, pdf_path: str):
 377      """Only replace the previous PDF after resources and diagrams finish rendering."""
 378      destination = Path(pdf_path).resolve()
 379      destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 380      with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=".md2pdf-", dir=destination.parent) as temp:
 381          tmp_html, tmp_pdf = Path(temp) / "document.html", Path(temp) / "document.pdf"
 382          tmp_html.write_text(html_content, encoding="utf-8")
 383          cmd = [
 384              "google-chrome", "--headless=new", "--disable-gpu", "--no-sandbox",
 385              "--disable-dev-shm-usage", "--no-first-run", "--no-default-browser-check",
 386              "--allow-file-access-from-files", f"--user-data-dir={temp}/profile",
 387              f"--print-to-pdf={tmp_pdf}", "--no-pdf-header-footer",
 388              "--virtual-time-budget=60000", "--dump-dom", tmp_html.as_uri(),
 389          ]
 390          try:
 391              result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
 392          except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
 393              print("  Chrome 转换超时；保留原 PDF")
 394              return False
 395          if result.returncode != 0 or not tmp_pdf.exists():
 396              print(f"  Chrome 错误；保留原 PDF: {result.stderr[:500]}")
 397              return False
 398          if 'data-render-status="ready"' not in result.stdout:
 399              error = re.search(r'data-render-error="([^"]*)"', result.stdout)
 400              print("  渲染未完成；保留原 PDF:", html_mod.unescape(error[1]) if error else "pending")
 401              return False
 402          if not tmp_pdf.read_bytes().startswith(b"%PDF-"):
 403              print("  PDF 输出无效；保留原 PDF")
 404              return False
 405          os.replace(tmp_pdf, destination)
 406      return True

 409  def main():
 410      md_files = [
 411          "自动舵定位与控制设计文档.md",
 412          "自动舵设计技术可行性分析文档.md",
 413          "软件设计与架构文档.md",
 414          "control/控制算法开发文档.md",
 415          "control/控制算法代码说明文档.md",
 416          "control/tools/README.md",
 417          "control/ui/README.md",
 418      ]
 419  
 420      # 支持命令行传入指定 md 文件（相对 BASE_DIR 的路径或绝对路径）
 421      args = sys.argv[1:]
 422      if args == ["--existing"]:
 423          # Refresh matching Markdown exports only; never rewrite source papers.
 424          candidates = subprocess.run(["rg", "--files", "-g", "*.md"], cwd=BASE_DIR,
 425                                      capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
 426          md_files = [name for name in sorted(candidates.stdout.splitlines())
 427                      if (Path(PDF_DIR) / (name[:-3].replace("/", "_") + ".pdf")).exists()]
 428      elif args:
 429          md_files = args
 430  
 431      os.makedirs(PDF_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 432      success = 0
 433      fail = 0
 434  
 435      for md_file in md_files:
 436          md_path = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, md_file)
 437          if not os.path.exists(md_path):
 438              print(f"[跳过] 文件不存在: {md_file}")
 439              fail += 1
 440              continue
 441  
 442          relative = os.path.relpath(md_path, BASE_DIR)
 443          pdf_stem = relative.replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_")
 444          pdf_name = os.path.splitext(pdf_stem)[0] + ".pdf"
 445          pdf_path = os.path.join(PDF_DIR, pdf_name)
 446  
 447          print(f"[转换] {md_file} → pdf_output/{pdf_name}")
 448          try:
 449              html_content = md_to_html(md_path)
 450              if html_to_pdf(html_content, pdf_path):
 451                  file_size = os.path.getsize(pdf_path)
 452                  print(f"  [OK] {pdf_name} ({file_size / 1024:.1f} KB)")
 453                  success += 1
 454              else:
 455                  print(f"  [失败] {pdf_name}")
 456                  fail += 1
 457          except Exception as e:
 458              print(f"  [错误] {e}")
 459              fail += 1
 460  
 461      print(f"\n完成: 成功 {success} 个, 失败 {fail} 个")
 462      print(f"PDF 输出目录: {PDF_DIR}")
 463      return bool(fail)
